notes.title: EA 0.9 Preview Build 3216 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! An update on the 0.9 update!

Is 0.9 still in experimental?
YES - With the big changes in 0.9, we've been listening to your feedback and balancing a few things before going live!
BUT - EA 0.9 is working pretty smoothly now after this patch and should be ending its experimental cycle very soon!

Weekly Imports / Urgent Orders:
First up - to address the weekly import change.

Many of you like the added challenge of needing to plan ahead, but most of you disliked that you had no ability to fix it if something went wrong.

Urgent Order for Importers - After discussing it with the community on Steam and Discord, we've added the Urgent Order option for Importers.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/a8678b0cb058df38c1f707936e281a1f21e4e665.png"]



just like you can get an emergency mid-week delivery from wholesalers, you can now also get that from the importers.

This allows you to fix any weekly ordering mistakes and not be stuck for a week. It will cost double for the convenience, but at least you can keep your empire rolling!
Changelog:
Balanced Import limits - increased the limits for most food items, and unified various item limits.

Removed Business School requirements for Gym and Hairdresser businesses

Fixed tutorial "Put best sellers on shelf" to proceed even if you only have one best seller.

Adjusted some help files

Better clarity on Wholesaler / Importer / Factory requirements for each store

Added Manhattan Business School Page

Updated Health Insurance and Marketing pages to be easier to search for

Fixed Industry City businesses (for real this time🤞)

MarketInsider shouldn't show 30+ clothing stores

This 30+ clothing store issue was causing constant backorders on clothing and cheap jewelry

Industry City businesses should be available to rent, whether it's a new save, 0.8 or 0.9 save!

Low-income rival businesses more likely to shut down now - previously they were holding onto micro-profits and businesses were rarely shutting down

Translations Fixes - broken links and missing translations should be updated

All retail D2 Installation layouts should be adjusted for the new bathrooms now


[hr][/hr]


After this weekend’s final testing, EA 0.9 is set to soon go live!

We’ll continue patching any issues you report, but the game should feel much smoother now. 

Thank you for your feedback and support in getting us here!


~ Hovgaard Games and the Big Ambitions Team!

notes.title: EA 0.9 Preview Build 3208 - Patch Notes
notes.content:

Hello again!

Friday's BIG PATCH squashed most of the major bugs, but as always, a big patch can sometimes kick up a few smaller bugs. We’ve tracked those down and fixed them too—thanks again for reporting them so quickly!


Changelog

Rival Stores
We had previously fixed some issues with rival stores, but a pesky typo had the stores reshuffling each time you loaded your save!

That has been fixed now - they will update one last time with this new patch, but after your next save, they should stay put!

This also fixed:

MarketInsider wasn't showing the correct number of competitors

Lowest Market Price wasn't behaving properly, so some sales weren't happening as they should

Some rival retail stores were being assigned to offices


General Fixes
Fixed Delivery Driver Job wasn't being included in weekly income

Interior Installation Firms

Bathrooms have been added to office and retail layouts

Uniform lockers have been added to retail layouts 

Adjusted office layouts in J1 and D2 buildings for the new floorplans.

Note: retail layouts are still being updated

Fixed collider on the Mersaidi Dash so it no longer sticks out too far

Fixed an infinite loop issue with conveyor belts in factories.

Updated some product icons

Fixed an issue placing items near the door in the I2 warehouse

Fixed pedestrians being blocked by warehouse entrances.

Fixed riding the subway from the park locked the happiness icon forever

Fixed a few small UI bugs


[hr][/hr]


Special shout out to you - the best community ever!! We love seeing your feedback and can’t wait to share what’s next.


~ Hovgaard Games, and the Big Ambitions Team

Balanced offices

Offices are stronger during their ideal hours

Rival offices should now more closely match those ideal hours to avoid losing money

Fixed base customer multiplier not set up on existing save games, causing low customer spawn

Fixed cannot sell items in Interior Designer if your bank balance is negative

Added fix to existing save games so Real Estate prices update to the new average prices

Fixed businesses suddenly stop getting customers

Fixed wholesalers having "shortages" for items they don't have

Fixed broken Wine resources cost


Tutorial
We did several small tutorial adjustments, mostly accounting for when you don't follow Fred's advice exactly or do things early!

Fixed bug that allowed duplication of Uncle Fred's car if selling before completing the objective

Fixed tutorial quest for supermarkets not accepting checkout counter as a point of sales

"Rent an office" autocompletes if you already have an HQ

"Rent a warehouse" autocompletes if you already have a warehouse

"Hire a Purchasing Agent" autocompletes if you use a headhunter

"Earn $100k" not progressing if there's any active loan

Changed some quests not triggering when the player is too advanced in the game


Industry City
Fixed some floating road props

Fixed 4 8th Avenue having the wrong building size (from H1 to I3)

Fixed some players still had buildings owned by Undefined

Added some one-way and do-not-enter traffic signs


Delivery Driver Job
Fixed van blinkers not working correctly

Fixed Ika deliveries including "for sale" versions of some items

Fixed job auto-completing wrongly under some scenarios

Changed objectives panel to open automatically when starting a delivery job

Changed color of GPS guider

Fixed issue where the same address could appear twice


Traffic
Fixed Essentials Appliances parking always full

Fixed parking lane in Industry City intersection not correctly set up

Fixed difficulty entering 23 10th Avenue

Fixed sunken parked vehicles around 10 24th Street

Fixed can't enter drive-in buildings if a cart was parked on the other side

Fixed bridge intersection has long traffic light times

Fixed collision issues when driving Anselmo AF 90 on the new bridge


General Bugs
Fixed Logistics Managers destination list not working when having businesses without names

Fixed employees not resigning after having an unmet demand

Fixed entrance fees being charged twice

Fixed can place items in C2 building corners overlapping the walls

Fixed Steam error when fetching stats causing errors at midnight in-game

Fixed bathroom blur running when it shouldn't

Increased Uncle Fred's dialog volume

Fixed some Store Managers don't have the correct overlay

Made the wholesaler signs click-through to the shelf

Fixed bathroom items not generating dirt during simulation

Fixed Interior Installation Firms installing items with full visual display (even though they are empty)

Fixed returning hand truck to station shows "Unassigned vehicle" notification

Fixed selling certain items in the Interior Designer mode would cause issues

Changed uniform selector in BizMan Settings to appear with a warning when no Uniform Lockers are in the building


[hr][/hr]

Thank you for all the feedback and reports! You've really helped get EA 0.9 ready for launch!



~ Hovgaard Games, and the Big Ambitions Team

notes.title: EA 0.9 - The Struggle: Preview
notes.content:
Good day to you!


Wouldn't it be great to preview an experimental branch for our huge EA 0.9 update? If you said yes, then good news...here it is!



The complete patch notes will be included when EA 0.9 is ready for its full release, but for now, here are the changes in EA 0.9.



Please notice: This version is unstable, unoptimized and might contain game-breaking bugs which may destroy your savegame. The branch will be updated frequently as we squeeze bugs. 



Similar to how we handled EA 0.8's preview branch, all progress/savegame will be retained once this testing period is over (assuming no major bugs are found - remember to make back up saves!) and your savegames will continue on through the full 0.9 release!



This is an opportunity to help us find bugs and get some early insight into the development of our next update. The experimental/preview version of the game is not simply a way to play the new update earlier. 



Please don't leave us negative reviews based on your experience with the experimental branch, thank you! ❤️


[hr][/hr]


There's a LOT of new stuff in this update, so let's walk through it all!


Brand New Tutorial
First up - we have a brand-new tutorial! For the most part, it should feel similar, but heavily upgrade. Several items were missing from the previous tutorial like Health Insurance and Headhunters, so we made sure to add those.



Plus, many of you have expressed that you don't want to have to create the same two stores every time you do the story mode, so now the tutorial allows you to start any wholesaler business and dynamically adjust the tasks based on what store you set up!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/2a28696589dc8931eec6394864ab3fd23bf40e8d.jpg"]

You might also notice we got a new Uncle Fred voice actor as well! Unfortunately, our amazing, original Uncle Fred actor, Mike McKay, has passed away, so now we welcome our new voice actor who has stepped up to fill his shoes, the impressive Jeff Pillars 



There are also some new "side quests" that pop up, based on what's happening in the game - like the first time a rival starts fighting you, Uncle Fred lets you know what's going on!



This new tutorial is ready to guide you through the latest and greatest version of Big Ambitions!


New Starter Delivery Job
Speaking of side jobs - we have a new starter job! For those who love the classics, you can still work at El Gato, but now you can spice it up with a new job option: the delivery driver!



Scattered around the city are vans that have deliveries waiting to go. These vans locations have a toggle in Voogle Maps to help you find them.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/a938bb6282069786494420345a71556086380e13.jpg"]

Once you take one of these delivery jobs, a timer starts ticking down for you to deliver items to three locations. Quickly make all three deliveries to earn your payday, but try not to damage the van - they'll deduct that from your earnings!



Upon returning the delivery van, you'll get paid for your services plus any tips from generous customers. Remember, faster deliveries can potentially earn more tips, so try to make the deliveries quickly!


Industry City
Speaking of driving around - remember that bridge that's been teasing "Opening Soon"? Well, that bridge is finally open and ready for you to venture across! What lays on the other side? Industry City! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/6070e7434e8972406448ca802faceef3710809bf.jpg"]

It's a whole new neighborhood for you to take over, build your factories and dominate the market!

Industry City brings 6 new warehouse sizes (P1, P2, P3, Q1, Q2, Q3), which are great for creating factories:  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/d0ce58d3dfd13125e30cd9747e44a6e6d232f7a8.png"]




New and Relocated Businesses
Okay along with these Industry City changes, some businesses have moved, so here's a handy guide to what's new and relocated! 

Titans of Industry Supply is a new wholesaler in Industry City

Stonegood Architecture is a new Interior Installation Firm in Industry City that now handles warehouse and factory blueprints.

You should now find some basic, default factory blueprints at the installation firm

Kristian Bahood continues to handle retail blueprints from their original location in Hell's Kitchen

Factory Supply Depot has moved to Industry City

US General Trucks has moved to Industry City

The Truck Repair garage (previously a garage hidden near US General Trucks) has also gotten a major facelift in Industry City and become a full truck gas station, IC Truckers.

There is a new clinic in Industry City.

This new clinic can't perform any Hospital surgeries, but at least you won't end up in Midtown after you pass out! 

Metro Wholesaler has moved up to Hell's Kitchen

⚠️ Note: If you had a residence in the rarely used, 18 1st St, unfortunately, you have been evicted, but you should receive an in-game refund for any items in that location!

StockCo is a new wholesaler in Midtown.

Have you noticed that blocked off ramp on 2nd Ave? Well, that's been opened up, and we've added a wholesaler 

There is also a new subway location in Lower Manhattan and a few locations in Industry City!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/b611bdb18e3e9ff28bd982975bd9d6978c434a7f.jpg"]
Blueprint Creator
Now for a highly requested feature to help you conquer NYC. While our goal with the game is a bit of immersion, many of you have asked for an easier way to build your new stores without having to run to the store 50 times! Well we think you'll love this new feature.



The Blueprint Creator is here to save the day! Quickly drop all the items you want for your store, and arrange them to set up your perfect layout.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/22e6a83777e177f4b46decfa8636f4e63f31f45d.jpg"]

New tools like the "duplicate" tool can copy an item with all of its attachments in one click - set up a desk with a chair, computer, mousepad, and everything you need, click the duplicate tool, hold shift and copy that full workstation with ease!

 Now you can make new layouts faster than ever! Once you're done just head over to the Interior Installation Firms and install your blueprints into your businesses.

While we were in there, we fixed a few other little things about blueprints:

You can preview your custom blueprints in the Interior Installation Firm preview kiosk!

If you subscribe to a blueprint on Steam, the game will now recognize it in your library without having to redownload it in game

You can now edit your blueprints and reupload them to Steam without needing to create a new Steam Workshop entry - allowing you to add new features to your existing blueprints!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/00b32c1d3eb7506cfd61a60f09726e07fae54be3.jpg"]


Bathrooms
Speaking of adding new features, that segues us to bathrooms! Don't worry - we didn't add a bladder meter to your character! This is for customers and employees, because they don't complain enough yet!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/fb858998f843fcb2d3eb692b1df1beced43b807c.png"]



In retail stores, customers will complain and your customer service score will go down if you don't have bathrooms. And in offices, bathrooms will now be required based on the building size.

⚠️ Note: If you load an existing save, offices will now require bathrooms or they won't earn money. To help ease this transition, you will find toilets and sinks in your office's "Delivery Spot" waiting for you! 



But just because bathrooms aren't required for your character, doesn't mean you can't use still them! Put a sink and toilet in your apartment, and buy yourself a shower! Your character will get a happiness boost from your good hygiene habits.



Plus, our art team added some bathroom decorations you can use as home decor!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/e911dd88416f63571cfd4b47d1d13562a65aa782.jpg"]
New Progression Update
Okay, but why is this update called "The Struggle" and what is a "Progression Update"? Great questions - let's dive in! 



It's no secret that you could previously start the game and be making millions if you create the right store in the right neighborhood. Well, now you can still do that, but it's going to be a bit more of a challenge to get to that point. You'll need to "progress" through a bit more "struggles" to get there.



To help balance this, though, "Easy" difficulty now adds a nice free boost of customers to your default traffic, and "Normal" adds a small boost as well!


Item Availability
The biggest change is what items are available from wholesalers and importers.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/278604a7664c5d2c8a8084e869455d9e0abe80bd.jpg"] 

All wholesalers now sell the same items and can provide inventory for:

Fast Food

Coffee Shop

Fruit and Vegetable Store

Supermarket

Florist

Hairdresser

Cheap Gifts

Each importer sells paper bags, sodas, and a unique selection of items. Importers can provide inventory for:

Bookstores

Liquor Stores

Nightclubs

Cheap Jewelry

Headphones / Earbuds

Cheap Clothing

And you will need a factory for the most profitable items:

Expensive Jewelry

Expensive Clothing

Smartphones

Smartwatches


Wholesaler and Importer Deliveries
Wholesaler and importer deliveries have had some updates as well. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/6ec9f393f60af228b31b6baf3a4d3b757393553d.png"]

Both importers and wholesalers now deliver in units instead of boxes since box sizes are different for each item

You can quickly see how much of an item you have sold and how much you ordered last week

No more "minimum order amount" - you can order 1 paper bag if you want!

You can now manually toggle "Smart Delivery" on or off

Deliveries happen once per week now on Monday morning, 08:00

Items now have a weekly ordering limit, but this is per location, so you can make separate orders from different wholesalers or importers


Warehouse Deliveries Van
The original van was in serious need of rebalancing, and it has been replaced with a new (more expensive) delivery van, the Mersaidi Dash.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/f76d324f7d30aa25bcc126176aa9fe5ddf962194.jpg"]

You'll still find the original van being used by the delivery job, so it hasn't been removed completely, but you won't be able to purchase it any longer!


Expenses
You might have noticed that rent is incredibly cheap - especially with no utility costs or upkeep! That has been increased a bit, especially for things like warehouses, making it a bit more of a jump to start using importers! 



Additionally, a few more business courses have been added to the "Manhattan Business School" that you will have to complete and pay for all the way up to factories!


Economy
Rivals and Market Events have gotten a little bit of an upgrade as well and should be a little more dynamic and reactive to your actions.


Rivals
For instance - you should now notice a distinct difference between the income of the rivals. The lowest earning rivals only use wholesaler stores, while some larger rivals use importers and wholesalers. And, of course, the special rivals are the top earners, selling everything they make from their own factories!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/7382efd313126ad63b46f8dd9b7b9cf6676a4861.jpg"]

Rivals should also now close their businesses more logically - if their business is doing well, they shouldn't randomly shut it down, and if you've driven their business to being unprofitable, they will shut it down and focus on the ones earning them money!



And finally, the rival income has been balanced to be more in-line with what players can earn as well! Rivals should no longer be earning more than the player can make at the same store.


Market Events
Market events are now more dynamic as well, so you'll have to watch your inventory!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/0f43838b89568c47ee97ed4dc1337d4efac8cbb4.png"]



The first time a new product is added to a neighborhood, that product should go on "Hype", increasing sales for a week. However, items that go on "Hype" often end up in a "Shortage" the following week.



Or if too many stores are ordering from the same wholesaler or importer, that item has a higher chance of going into a Shortage. And finally, if you continue to order an item that is in shortage, it has a chance of going fully out of stock and into "backorder".

Balancing
In addition to balancing the rivals income compared to the players, store income has been rebalanced a bit as well, and some of the worst performing stores have been improved a lot! 



Florist and Fruit and Vegetable stores can now make decent money (although they use a lot of inventory), and nightclubs are now much more profitable during the weekend!



And in exciting news: REAL ESTATE rent has been balanced! Now rather than taking 450 years to earn back the millions you are paying for a building, you can earn back your investment after a few decades!


Previously Unused Items
Two items that have existed, but weren't functional have been activated!

The Uniform Locker is now required to change employee uniforms 

Changing Rooms are now required for clothing stores

⚠️ Note: If you load an existing save, clothing stores will now require changing rooms or they won't earn money. To help ease this transition, you will find changing rooms in your clothing store's "Delivery Spot" waiting for you! 


New Art
Beyond the entire Industry City, new buildings and bathrooms, our art team decided to add even more new props, including:



Window Curtains

Roller Blinds

Venetian Blinds

Air Conditioners

New room dividers

New Bathroom Decorations

A new "Fruit Pallet" to sell fruits and vegetables

Wall Mounted TV Stand (as seen on our artist / dev live stream!)

And more!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/e2be7e2a4ed45b21ce67e15e979e0f902005ec6c.jpg"]\\

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/005e1aac80ce1290ece9ca521212085690bef74c.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/cbbea7d3430fc219572d74d7fbdee4b4aa40ba70.png"]  
Quality of Life
Storage and Bathroom areas have been added to D2 and J1 size buildings!

You can now overtake a business even after buying the building

When looking over candidates in your MyEmployees app, we added a "Hire and Assign" feature so you can hire and assign many recruits much faster

Want to change up how your character looks? In addition to changing hair, beards and eyebrows at the hairdresser, you can now visit Mr. Ternity at the hospital for a quick "plastic surgery" option to redesign your character!

All decorative items should now be in the help files.  Several Areas were expanded as well to give more detail on many sections!

In a Custom Game mode, you now start with full energy (previously it matched the old story mode where you started tired).

You can now put the flatbed in the V150 and Nunavut vehicles

The appliances stores should now have flatbeds and hand trucks available for use


Bugs
And tons of bug fixes - the full list will be included with the full changelog!


Known Issues
You currently can't fully interact with the Sunset park gym items. That will be fixed

You currently can't enter the pool area at Sunset park. That will be fixed!


[hr][/hr]
Please notice: This version is unstable, unoptimized and might contain game-breaking bugs which may destroy your savegame. The branch will be updated frequently as we squeeze bugs. 



Similar to how we handled EA 0.8's preview branch, all progress/savegame will be retained once this testing period is over (assuming no major bugs are found - remember to make back up saves!) and your savegames will continue on through the full 0.9 release!



This is an opportunity to help us find bugs and get some early insight into the development of our next update. The experimental/preview version of the game is not simply a way to play the new update earlier. 



Please don't leave us negative reviews based on your experience with the experimental branch, thank you! ❤️


Here's how to access the branch:


Right-click Big Ambitions on Steam

Select Properties

Select Betas

From the dropdown menu, choose "experimental - Use at own risk - Unstable!"

[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//40572925/8d2d6f2175c34e000d6706740f6d07bc802305ae.gif"]


Good luck!

Remember to submit Bug Reports!


If you see something weird while in-game, be sure to hit F2 to submit a bug report so we can fix it! Any information on what you did before the bug occured are greatly appreciated.



If you have additional information to contribute, or need a response, the best option is to create a thread on Steam, Reddit, Big Ambitions Forums, or our Discord, then mention that thread in the Bug Report, so we know it's yours and can reply to you!



As always, huge thanks to all of you for the support you give. Every comment, bug report, feedback and words of encouragement means the world to us. You make this whole thing possible. So from the bottom of our hearts, thank you!



~ Hovgaard Games and the entire Big Ambitions team!

notes.title: Blueprint Submissions for Rivals Stores
notes.content:
Hello!We have a little announcement! 

Firstly - in case you missed it, we just had a patch for EA 0.8 to fix a couple bugs:
EA 0.8 Patch Changelog
 
But now, let's talk about something more exciting:
EA 0.9's Blueprint Creator and new rival store layouts!

Industry City, a new neighborhood with larger warehouses for factories

A new starter "delivery job"

A blueprint creator

This is where YOU come in!

We wanted to give you the opportunity to try out our new Blueprint Creator and submit your own blueprints to be considered for these new rival store layouts!

notes.title: EA 0.8 - Optimization #3
notes.content:
Big Ambitions EA 0.8: Optimization #3

[previewyoutube=gE78hKO5Xn0;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings, business moguls!

We've got some major quality-of-life updates coming your way, including some highly requested features!

So let's take a look at all the upgrades!

Box Consolidation
This was a big one! Until now, none of your employees knew how to combine boxes, which was a big problem when your shelves were full of mostly empty boxes! Well, we taught them how to fix this!

If you're already experiencing this problem in a save, we've got you! When you first load into your current savegame, it should automatically merge the partial boxes together for each store / warehouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/7d384fd5ad3fc2ed18a6f49d69956a56b9c4f83f.png

Next, when you ship goods from your warehouse, it will start with the partial boxes and ship those first, making sure it doesn't leave multiple partial boxes behind. 

Then, logistics deliveries and wholesale deliveries will start by filling up the display shelves. Once those are full, they will fill any partial boxes, and finally, if there any items left over, they will be stored in new boxes!

Oh, and while we were at it, we realized using a whole box for one mousepad was silly, so now you can pack multiple of the same small products into one box!

Character Generator
You know what's better than only two character heads and two shirts to choose from?

A LOT MORE OPTIONS! We agree, so we present to you the brand new character creator!

With beards and mustaches, several more hair options, more clothing, and customization of each facial feature, our artists have completely redone the character creating experience! It's time for you to look like you...or whoever you want to look like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/1ddc6d8b9c7611338dbd83888a6b11d06a54bd59.gif

Auto-scheduler and Schedule UI Revamp
"Wow, HR did a great job setting up my company's schedule!!" That has probably not been your reaction to the auto-schedule feature in previous versions of the game.

Well, that's about to change! The auto-scheduler now checks employee demands and splits the shifts a lot better to keep them happy. You can even choose to only autofill one day instead of the whole schedule!

And if you want to manually control things, the scheduler UI is much more powerful now. You can copy/paste specific days and rename workstations to quickly search and find things. Plus, the new employee search filters make it much easier to find the exact employees you're looking for!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/524440de7153b5d1c973739ce7b56f2dbd85889c.png

Placement and Attachment Updates
As the game has gotten more complex, we've realized we needed a whole new placement system.

Some of these big changes in EA 0.8 include:

 General improvements to placing objects on the floors
 A full rewrite on how you can place items on and under desks and tables
 You can now grab and pack display shelves with items in them instead of needing to unpack them first!
 And most exciting, you can rapidly place items directly from the delivery spot or hand truck! Much less clicking now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/178829954e9ac33e4ec02b57f83dfeabddd1a256.png

Interior Wall Hider
Speaking of placing things, don't you hate when you're trying to put things on the floor, and the walls keep blocking your view? Now you can toggle between walls up, walls down, or an exterior "cut out" mode!

Keep an eye on your store better than ever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/aac083d9a7a178bdad38c243afa0873e730c9dca.png

Notification Consolidation
How many times have you missed the IRS notification because it was buried under a wall of other alerts? We fixed that too!

If you receive several notifications of the same type, they will be grouped together:

Instead of seeing 10 individual pop-ups, you'll see "10 Employees messaged you"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/cc9537033d5c291fbd8fec723c71f097db26ca21.png

This will make the red alerts like the IRS more noticeable!

Additionally, if your Logistics Manager is unable to deliver product to any of its stores, you will get 1 message from that manager, with a summary of anything that was not delivered!

Turn Signals, Dirt and Car Washes
Our vehicles got a few visual updates as well!

Lots of players have requested turn signals and have noted that the reverse lights don't always work, so we fixed those! The angry drivers in the city will still ignore your signals and cut you off, but at least you can be polite!

While you're driving around the city, you'll start to notice the car getting dirty. Don't worry, you can wash it next time you're at the repair shop, or just wait until it rains and let nature help you out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/90ef066dc12bff70efead2e92f085add8f0a20ad.png

Plus, the Missam Villian vehicle has been upgraded

 The old model has a lot of issues, so we upgraded it
 It has been replaced with the new vehicle the Lytte L6
 The new vehicle can be found at Manhattan Luxury Vehicles
 If you previously owned the Villain, it has been automatically upgraded to the Lytte! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/6596cf235e801ec8cba623259c16b06abb19b0f5.png

New Items and Accessories

Job Board
Headhunters and recruiters are great, but what happened to the old-fashion walk-in?

Now you can buy a Job Board and place it in your store to attract some employees. They might not be the highest-skilled workers, but it's the easiest way to recruit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/1c929265f2ecc55e8f2994f918ae2bd6a028c633.png

Be sure to keep an eye on the Employees > Recruits page when these employees pop up!

Umbrellas
We added rain, but forgot to give you an umbrella! Well we fixed that in 0.8! You can carry an umbrella and equip it in the rain to stay dry and avoid any negative happiness from being wet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/9e6f1dcd2ac6476572b7ec0e067afc4297a88dcd.png

In fact - you can now sell umbrellas in your gift shops too! Be sure to pick up a Product Panel and start selling them!

Wearable Headphones and Earbuds
Next, we've heard the requests - you want to wear headphones to listen to your music station whenever you want. Well, now you can! You can equip a pair of headphones or earbuds to your character!

Usable Items
Next up - "I bought this outfit, now what?" Well, you should put it in your wardrobe!

 Both the current Wardrobe and the new Wall-Mounted Wardrobe can now hold clothes
 The new Fruit Bowl can hold your fruit (Apples, Bananas and Pears)
 Your Decorative Bookshelf can now be loaded with books (grab a book from the shelf to read it)
 The new Jewelry Case can protect your Jewelry
 Use the new Umbrella Stand to hold your umbrellas
 Your Headphone or Earbud Stands can hold headphones and earbuds
 Plus, place your gifts and flowers around the house!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/cb4fc288d4124c4170edb458c7de3acdd4cbaee6.png

Quality of Life / Bugs

This update was filled with many little tweaks and fixes, in addition to everything listed above. Here are some more things to look out for!

General Code Optimization
We did a lot of work with more optimization, especially when it comes to massive lists.

Deliveries, inventory, employees, businesses, store layouts - pretty much anywhere with a massive list or number of items - have all been optimized and refactored to make the game run smoother!

Launching the game has been optimized, which should hopefully help some computers that were struggling to launch!
Quality of Life

 Optimized the time-skip blur effect to avoid GPU spikes
 Add permanent taxi spot to the hospital
 You can now make multiple deliveries from each furniture store per day!
 Gym Customers now use the showers
 Added more information to employee complaints
 Added ability to cancel blueprint orders
 Replaced phone message alert with a less abrasive sound
 Added "Unlock All Contacts" option for custom games
 Income Updates

 Fixed inconsistent income behavior, so all midnight expenses are charged to the current day instead of some being charged to the next day
 Adjusted negative interest to be calculated before your Sunday income is added to avoid it being adding to the negative interest fee
 To avoid more confusion, we changed the end-of-day pop-up to now show how much your bank account changed at midnight. You can still see your store's profitability in the EconoView page, though!
 Note: If you already have a savegame going, the first day or two might appear to have double charges or no charges due to these changes, but it should all appear properly after that!
 New Options

 SFX Audio Volume Slider
 Competitor Store Music Volume Slider
 Enable / Disable Seasonal decorations
 Gamma / Brightness
 New Map Filters

 Map now has a search filter
 "Enable/Disable All" Toggle
 "Rented By You" Toggle
 "Hide Closed businesses" Toggle
Bugs

 A large number of UI  and text fixes and clarifications
 UMC Desert Wheels weren't all aligned properly
 Lux Concept was missing the Pinecone Light
 Removed random bag from Ika Coffee Shop floor
 Ika no longer sells the Pinecone Light
 Fixed hole in map near roundabout

 Fixed Delivery Drivers show "0 hours" assigned
 Fixed issue with blueprints with illegal characters causing problems

 Fixed issue where you can name your business an empty space
 Fixed building at 8 9th St didn't have an accessible entrance
 Fixed issue with gym shower having an incorrect collider if placed near a door
 Fixed if you adjust the pullup bar in Interior Designer mode, it doesn't update the height alert
 Shrunk collider size of Small Sign with Text
 Fixed many exteriors were showing the wrong floor when the building hider was active
 Fixed / updated many textures
 Fixed lighting inside buildings
 Fixed US General Trucks wasn't randomizing interior vehicle colors 
 Fixed several issues where players could get stuck in an activity with no UI
 Removed theft and security warnings from businesses that don't have theft
 Fixed issue if you leave the casino after resting on a chair and start navigating prior to reaching the ticket booth, no UI appears
 Fixed if you type a randomly large number for starting money in a custom game, you wouldn't get the full $2 billion
 Fixed some issues where time wouldn't pause properly
 Fixed issue where you couldn't adjust the logistics deliveries if you were delivering all the items to another warehouse immediately after receiving them
 Fixed Coat Check not being listed as a required item and not showing up in the insights panel
 Fixed if a business closes at midnight, it said "closing at 12pm"

 Fixed current employees not being unassigned after installing a blueprint

[hr][/hr]

We hope you enjoy all these new features and updates!

And as you expand your business empire, our team will be busy expanding Big Ambitions for our next MASSIVE update, 0.9!

~Hovgaard Games, and the Big Ambitions Team

Changelog

 Fixed Office Desk (Right) couldn't attach chairs

 Fixed Headhunter could find employees with "None_skills"

 Fixed the missing blue dot in the Logistics Manager that indicates primary products for that store
 Fixed autopark sometimes makes vehicles shake and bounce around
 Added a warning if you try to use a computer when you're not in your home
 Fixed an issue if you switch items that a display shelf is selling.
 Updated some help files
 Fixed some clothing glitches
 Fixed some employee equipment demands weren't being recognized when properly fulfilled
 Fixed an issue if you looked the rivals, then changed your appearance (changing clothes, daily aging, etc), you would take the rival's appearance
 Fixed headlights on Lytte weren't very visibly bright
 Partially fixed using movers to move desks is broken with our new placement system 

 You should be able to safely use the movers now!
 Note: If you already had a move that glitched items, your missing items should be in that building's delivery spot
 Note: Some items might be rotated the wrong way. We'll continue fixing this!
 Fixed issue with "no cleaning shifts" demand being improperly unfulfilled, if you had previously assigned them to a cleaning station

 Note: If your employee currently has this bug, unassign them from that station and reassign them, and it should reset!

Known Issues

notes.title: EA 0.8 - Optimization #3: Preview
notes.content:
Hello there!

Spring is in the air, so it's time for us to share our latest experimental build with you!

The team has been working hard to bring you a big new update - another optimization update packed with tons of quality-of-life upgrades, giving you more control over your business empire! Dive in and help us test and refine this new update!

The complete patch notes will be included when EA 0.8 is ready for its full release, but for now, here is a summary of the bigger changes in EA 0.8.

Please notice: This version is unstable, unoptimized and might contain game-breaking bugs which may destroy your savegame. The branch will be updated frequently as we squeeze bugs.

Unlike previous experimental builds, however, all progress/savegame will be retained once this testing period is over (assuming no major bugs are found - remember to make back up saves!) and your savegames will continue on through the full 0.8 release! 

This is an opportunity to help us find bugs and get some early insight into the development of our next update. The experimental/preview version of the game is not simply a way to play the new update earlier. 

Please don't leave us negative reviews based on your experience with the experimental branch, thank you! ❤️
[hr][/hr]
Box Consolidation
This was a big one! Until now, none of your employees knew how to combine boxes, which was a big problem when your shelves were full of mostly empty boxes! Well, we taught them how to fix this!

If you're already experiencing this problem in a save, we've got you! When you first load into your current savegame, it should automatically merge the partial boxes together for each store / warehouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/7d384fd5ad3fc2ed18a6f49d69956a56b9c4f83f.png

Next, when you ship goods from your warehouse, it will start with the partial boxes and ship those first, making sure it doesn't leave multiple partial boxes behind. 

Then, logistics deliveries and wholesale deliveries will start by filling up the display shelves. Once those are full, they will fill any partial boxes, and finally, if there any items left over, they will be stored in new boxes!

Oh, and while we were at it, we realized using a whole box for one mousepad was silly, so now you can pack multiple of the same small products into one box!

Character Generator
You know what's better than only two character heads and two shirts to choose from?

A LOT MORE OPTIONS! We agree, so we present to you the brand new character creator!

With beards and mustaches, several more hair options, more clothing, and customization of each facial feature, our artists have completely redone the character creating experience! It's time for you to look like you...or whoever you want to look like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/1ddc6d8b9c7611338dbd83888a6b11d06a54bd59.gif

Auto-scheduler and Schedule UI Revamp
"Wow, HR did a great job setting up my company's schedule!!" That has probably not been your reaction to the auto-schedule feature in previous versions of the game.

Well, that's about to change! The auto-scheduler now checks employee demands and splits the shifts a lot better to keep them happy. You can even choose to only autofill one day instead of the whole schedule!

And if you want to manually control things, the scheduler UI is much more powerful now. You can copy/paste specific days and rename workstations to quickly search and find things. Plus, the new employee search filters make it much easier to find the exact employees you're looking for!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/524440de7153b5d1c973739ce7b56f2dbd85889c.png

Placement and Attachment Updates
As the game has gotten more complex, we've realized we needed a whole new placement system.

Some of these big changes in EA 0.8 include:

 General improvements to placing objects on the floors
 A full rewrite on how you can place items on and under desks and tables
 You can now grab and pack display shelves with items in them instead of needing to unpack them first!
 And most exciting, you can rapidly place items directly from the delivery spot or hand truck! Much less clicking now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/178829954e9ac33e4ec02b57f83dfeabddd1a256.png

Interior Wall Hider
Speaking of placing things, don't you hate when you're trying to put things on the floor, and the walls keep blocking your view? Now you can toggle between walls up, walls down, or an exterior "cut out" mode!

Keep an eye on your store better than ever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/aac083d9a7a178bdad38c243afa0873e730c9dca.png

Notification Consolidation
How many times have you missed the IRS notification because it was buried under a wall of other alerts? We fixed that too!

If you receive several notifications of the same type, they will be grouped together:

Instead of seeing 10 individual pop-ups, you'll see "10 Employees messaged you"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/cc9537033d5c291fbd8fec723c71f097db26ca21.png

This will make the red alerts like the IRS more noticeable!

Additionally, if your Logistics Manager is unable to deliver product to any of its stores, you will get 1 message from that manager, with a summary of anything that was not delivered!

Turn Signals, Dirt and Car Washes
Our vehicles got a few visual updates as well!

Lots of players have requested turn signals and have noted that the reverse lights don't always work, so we fixed those! The angry drivers in the city will still ignore your signals and cut you off, but at least you can be polite!

While you're driving around the city, you'll start to notice the car getting dirty. Don't worry, you can wash it next time you're at the repair shop, or just wait until it rains and let nature help you out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/90ef066dc12bff70efead2e92f085add8f0a20ad.png

Plus, the Missam Villian vehicle has been upgraded

 The old model has a lot of issues, so we upgraded it
 It has been replaced with the new vehicle the Lytte L6
 The new vehicle can be found at Manhattan Luxury Vehicles
 If you previously owned the Villain, it has been automatically upgraded to the Lytte! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/6596cf235e801ec8cba623259c16b06abb19b0f5.png

New Items and Accessories

Job Board
Headhunters and recruiters are great, but what happened to the old-fashion walk-in?

Now you can buy a Job Board and place it in your store to attract some employees. They might not be the highest-skilled workers, but it's the easiest way to recruit!

Be sure to keep an eye on the Employees > Recruits page when these employees pop up!

Umbrellas
We added rain, but forgot to give you an umbrella! Well we fixed that in 0.8! You can carry an umbrella and equip it in the rain to stay dry and avoid any negative happiness from being wet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/9e6f1dcd2ac6476572b7ec0e067afc4297a88dcd.png

In fact - you can now sell umbrellas in your gift shops too! Be sure to pick up a Product Panel and start selling them!

Wearable Headphones and Earbuds
Next, we've heard the requests - you want to wear headphones to listen to your music station whenever you want. Well, now you can! You can equip a pair of headphones or earbuds to your character!

Usable Items
Next up - "I bought this outfit, now what?" Well, you should put it in your wardrobe!

 Both the current Wardrobe and the new Wall-Mounted Wardrobe can now hold clothes
 The new Fruit Bowl can hold your fruit (Apples, Bananas and Pears)
 Your Decorative Bookshelf can now be loaded with books (grab a book from the shelf to read it)
 The new Jewelry Case can protect your Jewelry
 Use the new Umbrella Stand to hold your umbrellas
 Your Headphone or Earbud Stands can hold headphones and earbuds
 Plus, place your gifts and flowers around the house!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/cb4fc288d4124c4170edb458c7de3acdd4cbaee6.png

Quality of Life / Bugs

This update was filled with many little tweaks and fixes, in addition to everything listed above. Here are some more things to look out for!

General Code Optimization
We did a lot of work with more optimization, especially when it comes to massive lists.

Deliveries, inventory, employees, businesses, store layouts - pretty much anywhere with a massive list or number of items - have all been optimized and refactored to make the game run smoother!

Launching the game has been optimized, which should hopefully help some computers that were struggling to launch!
Quality of Life

 Optimized the time-skip blur effect to avoid GPU spikes
 Add permanent taxi spot to the hospital
 You can now make multiple deliveries from each furniture store per day!
 Gym Customers now use the showers
 Added more information to employee complaints
 Added ability to cancel blueprint orders
 Replaced phone message alert with a less abrasive sound
 Added "Unlock All Contacts" option for custom games
 Income Updates

 Fixed inconsistent income behavior, so all midnight expenses are charged to the current day instead of some being charged to the next day
 Adjusted negative interest to be calculated before your Sunday income is added to avoid it being adding to the negative interest fee
 To avoid more confusion, we changed the end-of-day pop-up to now show how much your bank account changed at midnight. You can still see your store's profitability in the EconoView page, though!
 Note: If you already have a savegame going, the first day or two might appear to have double charges or no charges due to these changes, but it should all appear properly after that!
 New Options

 SFX Audio Volume Slider
 Competitor Store Music Volume Slider
 Enable / Disable Seasonal decorations
 Gamma / Brightness
 New Map Filters

 Map now has a search filter
 "Enable/Disable All" Toggle
 "Rented By You" Toggle
 "Hide Closed businesses" Toggle
Bugs
And tons of bug fixes - the full list will be included with the full changelog!

[hr][/hr]
Please notice: This version is unstable, unoptimized and might contain game-breaking bugs which may destroy your savegame. The branch will be updated frequently as we squeeze bugs. 

Unlike previous experimental builds, however, all progress/savegame will be retained once this testing period is over (assuming no major bugs are found - remember to make back up saves!) and your savegames will continue on through the full 0.8 release!

This is an opportunity to help us find bugs and get some early insight into the development of our next update. The experimental/preview version of the game is not simply a way to play the new update earlier. 

Please don't leave us negative reviews based on your experience with the experimental branch, thank you! ❤️


Here's how to access the branch:


 Right-click Big Ambitions on Steam
 Select Properties
 Select Betas
 From the dropdown menu, choose "experimental - Use at own risk - Unstable!"


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/8d2d6f2175c34e000d6706740f6d07bc802305ae.gif

Good luck!

Remember to submit Bug Reports!

If you see something weird while in-game, be sure to hit F2 to submit a bug report so we can fix it! Any information on what you did before the bug occured are greatly appreciated.

If you have additional information to contribute, or need a response, the best option is to create a thread on Steam, Reddit, Big Ambitions Forums, or our Discord, then mention that thread in the Bug Report, so I know it's yours and can reply to you!

As always, huge thanks to all of you for the support you give. Every comment, bug report, feedback and words of encouragement means the world to us. You make this whole thing possible. So from the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

~ Hovgaard Games and the entire Big Ambitions team!

notes.title: EA 0.7 Build 2851 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello and Happy New Year! 

Let's kick off the New Year with some fixes for EA 0.7!

Firstly - we've seen the reports of some players getting stuck in the loading screens. With this patch, we've made a few changes to the loading system, which we're hoping greatly reduces the issues people are having here!

If you're still having issues launching, scroll to the bottom of this post for some suggestions!

Changelog Build 2851:

 Fix couldn't enter 8 12th Street warehouse
 Fix can skip time repeatedly using the hotkey
 Fix player working doesn't stop skipping time when an employee shift starts
 Fix can't rent player-owned building
 Fix Manhattan Movers not initialized correctly
 Fix some old savegames can't enter gas stations
 Fix electric scooter despawning too soon
 Fix cars taking damage in ramps
 Fix loudspeakers desyncing
 Fix customer complaint after trying to buy overpriced items
 Fix chance of AI seeking trash bins
 Double speed of throw-away-trash animation
 Fixed issue causing corners to become unpainted
 Fix interior design floor/wall folding mode issues with new design
 Fix unable to place objects on rugs
 Fix stage lights stacking on other objects
 Fix issues that happen when you pass out while holding mop or cleaning
 Fix vehicle/garage collider, especially when reversing a freight truck into a warehouse
 Fix cash registers containing unneeded paper bags
 Fix can't interact with paper bags on workstations
 Fix wrong average player business income (BizMan & Rivals apps)
 Fix sitting pedestrian in benches triggering hider
 Fix business logo generator not matching custom logo settings
 Fix employee getting stuck if can't reach an item they are trying to get
 Add compact fix for IRS with wrong business type
 Fix slot machine texture
 Fix interior installation firm and furniture delivery message address not being localized
 Fix vehicle taking damage when leaving NY Distro
 Fix blueprints Min/Max Price sorting not working
 Update treadmill Icon
 Fix can walk around on Casino while playing games
 Fix incorrect supercar capacity calculation
 Fix issues with employee tasks and objectives and calls
 Fix Tall Potted Plant can be placed in tables
 Fix incorrect layering in the object placement system

Stuck in Loading Screen
If you're still having issues getting the game launched, here are some suggestions that might help.

Firstly, make sure your computer drivers are up-to-date!

Also, keep in mind that if the game crashes while loading on a slower system, that's a good thing! Launch again, and the game should detect that it crashed, and should lower the settings!

If that still doesn't get the game working, you can try to add these launch parameters:

 On Steam, right-click Big Ambitions and go to "Properties".
 In the "General" tab, add this to the "Launch Options" section:
 -screen-quality Low -screen-fullscreen 0 -screen-width 1024 -screen-height 768

However, some of these issues are from Mac computers, and the issue seems to be between the Mac OS and Steam. But we have a few methods that have helped several people as well:
[olist]
 Disable "Game Mode" for the Mac, as that can sometimes cause issues.
 Restarting the computer sometimes fixes it, and if not, reintalling the game often does the trick.
 If it's still not working, reverting versions might clear the issue:

 On Steam, right-click Big Ambitions and go to "Properties".
 Under "Betas", choose "EA 0.5".
 Then let the game update back to EA 0.5.
 Try to launch the game, then exit the game.
 Go back to "Properties" and select "None" to switch to the current version.
 Let the game update to the latest version.
 Try to launch the game.
[/olist]
If that still isn't solving the issue for you:

Please email us at Support@Hovgaard.com so we can take a look!

Please include:

 Your operating system / version
 Your GPU / graphics card drivers
 The PlayerLog ("Player" and "Player-prev") files and anything in the "Crash" folder (located in the folder nested above the save games)

[hr][/hr]

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and motivation as we continue improving the game!

~Hovgaard Games, and the Big Ambitions team!

notes.title: Studio & Future Insights #3
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
As we approach the end of another exciting year, I wanted to take a moment to share some updates about Big Ambitions and our journey at Hovgaard Games.

500,000 Copies Sold!
First and foremost, we're thrilled to announce that Big Ambitions has reached a milestone of 500,000 copies sold! We are incredibly grateful for your support and for being part of this amazing community. Your passion and feedback continue to drive us forward.

Success with the Experimental Branch
Earlier this year, we introduced the Experimental Branch to allow for more robust testing of new features and updates before they hit the live version. We're happy to report that this approach has been a resounding success. Thanks to your participation and invaluable feedback, we've been able to catch and address issues more efficiently. We'll definitely be continuing with this strategy moving forward.

More Frequent Updates
Listening to your feedback, we've decided to shift our development approach to focus on smaller, more frequent updates. Our goal is to release new content approximately every three months, giving us some flexibility to ensure each update meets our quality standards.

Updated Living Roadmap
Our Living Roadmap has been updated to reflect our plans leading up to the full release of Big Ambitions. You'll notice that we've added "Full Release" to the list. While this is not set in stone, it reflects our plan to stay in Early Access for at least another 12 months.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/e227e24a7e13617b45bb9e1cb4b853d839a0c462.png

Expanding the Hovgaard Games Team
In line with our growth plans, we've successfully expanded our team to 10 full-time members. Their talents are already making a significant impact on the game's development.

While we're not actively recruiting at the moment, we're always on the lookout for experienced and passionate individuals who share our love for management and tycoon games. If that's you, feel free to drop us an email at jobs@hovgaard.com or DM me on Discord.

Thank You for Your Support
Lastly, I want to express my deepest gratitude to all of you. Your positive reviews, constructive feedback, and enthusiastic support mean the world to us.

Here's to an exciting year ahead!

All the best, 
Jonas 
Founder, Hovgaard Games

notes.title: EA 0.7 Build 2848 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We're ready with the first patch for EA 0.7 (out of experimental). Thank you for all your bug reports. Keep them coming! 💪

The drop in sales
Unfortunately, a lot of players experienced up to 50% fewer customers/sales in their businesses after switching to 0.7. The reason for this is while we worked on 0.7, we found a bug in the way we calculate customers per hour which effectively ignored the building's limitation.

This led to unrealistically high incomes for those businesses, so it had to be fixed. The mistake was really that we introduced this change to existing savegames, instead of only new savegames. This patch will fix that, so all of you, existing players, will continue having the same high volume of customers.

Moving forward, we'll start increasing the time the update spent in "experimental" so we hopefully catch things like this in the future before releasing it to the public branch.

Changelog:

 Fixed sudden drop in sales for some existing savegames
 Reduced energy consumption by gym equipment by 50%
 Fixed various font/text issues
 Fixed lighting issues in IKA
 Fixed issue causing players to get stuck when doing various activities
 Fixed bug causing some players not being able to access Factory Supply Depot

notes.title: EA 0.7 - Optimization #2
notes.content:
Big Ambitions EA 0.7: Optimization #2

[previewyoutube=JXVGxZFoZUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello to our big-shot business owners!

We know the last update took a really long time, so this update is coming faster than ever! It's a smaller update that focuses on optimization and quality of life, but we also got a few new features in it as well!

So let's dive into what's new!

Player-Owned Gym Business
You no longer have to choose between working out at home or at the city gym! Now you (and your rivals) can make your own gym businesses!

To go along with this, we added a bunch of new exercises and equipment! So go jump on the Fitness Trampolines and do situps on the Fitball! Plus we added new equipment like the Squats Station! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/481704ee726a5912de402f88eb567f0d9a31700f.png

And lastly, we added a way to make your daily workouts more effective! Click on the Gym Training Board to add a personalized workout plan for an extra daily happiness boost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/dd065a55b9434ddc7568cdec6241e498036a6c64.png

New Game Menu - Full Revamp

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/c47b66df8ac5d7ed5052b72a5a4e384613de7370.png

We updated this new game screen to match our new streamlined UI while also addressing a few frequent quality of life issues:

1) Better explanation of the differences between the difficulties
2) Custom game settings can be defaulted to easy/medium/hard, then customized and saved!
3) Added option "No vehicle damage" when starting a custom game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/af5fa7151babf752f9df560fde0b10f2ccf746c4.png

Art Upgrades

We added a few nice visual upgrades in this update as well!

Cleaning Employees
Your cleaners are no longer invisible! Now you'll see the employees walking around and cleaning, so you don't have to wonder why they didn't show up to work!

And while we were in there, we also improved the cleaning animation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/178eb61abc67d7c76a09cdd48d176691ac2e7a01.png

Rain
We did it - we added rain!! It's purely a visual (and audio) element that won't impact business, but it's cool!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/4595f90d1b02ebd9889430b91cd3abfbf6c2cdce.png

This visual upgrade brings a whole new level of atmosphere to the game - just watch out for all the umbrellas and puddles on the street now!

New Flower Display Stand

Do you want something unique to show off your flowers in your Florist Shop? Well, we've got you covered!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/b21dc136c0464dc65257b445a32a803122804eb0.png

Ika - Full Revamp

Last, but certainly not least on the art side, your favorite furniture store just got a major glow-up! IKA’s new design is more realistic and immersive, making shopping for decor even more enjoyable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/e2f0e5fdc6e01eead0425ab314bc1a373dcfc619.png

But that’s not all—IKA now features its very own cafeteria! Who says business can’t be delicious?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/2a2f1b98466e25d40c772b6b95df5e9177b2184c.png

Launch Issues / Crashes
Some players with older machines have been reporting difficulty with getting the game launched, so we have added a few changes. 

Firstly, we changed how the game loads in, which should help some systems already. However, if your computer is going slow - have patience and let it run through its process. If the game crashes, try to launch it again. It should automatically recognize that it crashed and should lower the settings when you try to launch again, increasing your chances of successfully launching! 

Quality of Life / Bugs

One of the big focuses for this update was to clean up, streamline, and optimize some code and graphics.

This should help greatly reduce or eliminate lag spikes for each new hour, new day, and at delivery times as well as make the game run more smoothly in general! 


 Improved taxi frequency, especially at night.
 Can put flatbed cart inside Freight and Courier trucks
 Added fade-out/fade-in when entering/exiting buildings for a smoother transition
 Camera no longer rotates when exiting a vehicle!
 You now enter a drive-in store and warehouse the same way you exit - by driving through the door!
 Fixed lighting in underground parking lots
 Fixed issue causing buildings to be owned by "undefined" when the rival shut them down
 Added ability to write custom text on glass barriers
 Fixed can't buy Checkout Counter (Right) from AJ Pederson if you're holding a cart
 Removed forklifts since they were causing lots of issues in warehouses and not being used much
 Added "Storage is Full" indicator to hand trucks, flatbeds and vehicles.
 Fixed issue causing rivals screen to break if a broken employee was poached
 Fixed issue where you could be parked "illegally" after using autopark
 Fixed issue where the truck repair shop would cause you to crash around after calling the tow truck
 Fixed issue causing the blueprints page to get stuck if you switched from blueprints to library in certain circumstance
 Fixed issue causing Interior Designer achievements not to be registered
 Lowered Casino ("Lucky Potato") achievement requirements
 Adjusted color of drive-in store product signs to be easier to read
 Fixed a couple issue with the interior designer not updating objectives
 Fixed an incorrect collider size of the industrial sewing machine
 Fixed lighting in the underground parking
 Fixed issue where you could grab a mop while already holding a box
 Fixed issue with windows flickering
 Fixed issue with delivery spots showing “Click to manage” in AI businesses
 Fixed an issue with switching business type
 Fixed inventory was sometimes lost if the customer didn't like the price
 Fixed an issue where paper bags weren't properly counted while you were in the store
 Fixed sometimes activity timers would reset to 1 hour
 Fixed an issue causing Electric Scooters to get stuck on their sides
 Fixed issue sometimes causing two music tracks to play at the casino
 Fixed issue where AI sometimes sits on player in chairs
 Fixed hanging sign lists don't change when you add new items to the store
 Fixed rotating an object then grabbing it doesn't reset rotation properly
 Fixed "free parking" if you cancel selling your car
 Fixed issue causing some damange when on parking ramp
 Updated money/number input
 Fixed import contract not cancelling when shutting down a warehouse
 Fixed can't grab cart in some cases
 Fixed can get stuck in queue if there are no paper bags in the register
 Added new animation for eating ice cream
 Removed restaurant LCD screens for sale as they currently are non-functional
 Fixed items not appearing properly in AI character's hands
 Fixed an issue where machines would output raw goods
 Note - if this already happened to you, you'll need to clear the item from the conveyor belt, but it shouldn't happen again. Please report it if you see it!

[hr][/hr]

We hope you enjoy this update and we look forward to bringing you another speedy update next! Our goal is to aim for closer to 3 months for future releases!

And finally don't forget to set up your Christmas tree before December 25th, and then click the tree on the 25th to get your 2024 holiday decoration!

~Hovgaard Games, and the Big Ambitions Team

notes.title: EA 0.7 - Optimization #2: Preview
notes.content:
Hello there!

Hopefully, you've been enjoying the holiday decorations that appear in the game around this time of year! And as an added holiday treat, we're excited to share our latest experimental build with you!

The team has been working hard to bring you the fastest update since launch - an optimization update designed to fine-tune your empire-building adventure. Dive in and help us test and refine this new update!

The complete patch notes will be released when EA 0.7 is ready for its full release, but for now, here is a summary of the bigger changes in EA 0.7.

Please notice: This version is unstable, unoptimized and might contain game-breaking bugs which may destroy your savegame. The branch will be updated frequently as we squeeze bugs. Any progress/savegame will be lost once this testing period is over. 

This is an opportunity to help us find bugs and get some early insight into the development of our next update. The experimental/preview version of the game is not simply a way to play the new update earlier. 

Please don't leave us negative reviews based on your experience with the experimental branch, thank you! ❤️

[hr][/hr]
Player-Owned Gym Business

You no longer have to choose between working out at home or at the city gym! Now you (and your rivals) can make your own gym businesses!

To go along with this, we added a bunch of new exercises and equipment! So go jump on the Fitness Trampolines and do situps on the Fitball! Plus we added new equipment like the Squats Station! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/481704ee726a5912de402f88eb567f0d9a31700f.png

And lastly, we added a way to make your daily workouts more effective! Click on the Gym Training Board to add a personalized workout plan for an extra daily happiness boost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/dd065a55b9434ddc7568cdec6241e498036a6c64.png

Cleaning Employees
Your cleaners are no longer invisible! Now you'll see the employees walking around and cleaning, so you don't have to wonder why they didn't show up to work!

And while we were in there, we also improved the cleaning animation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/178eb61abc67d7c76a09cdd48d176691ac2e7a01.png

Rain
We did it - we added rain!! It's purely a visual (and audio) element that won't impact business, but it's cool!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/4595f90d1b02ebd9889430b91cd3abfbf6c2cdce.png

This visual upgrade brings a whole new level of atmosphere to the game - just watch out for all the umbrellas and puddles on the street now!

New Game Menu - Full Revamp

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/c47b66df8ac5d7ed5052b72a5a4e384613de7370.png

We updated this new game screen to match our new streamlined UI while also addressing a few frequent quality of life issues:

1) Better explanation of the differences between the difficulties
2) Custom game settings can be defaulted to easy/medium/hard, then customized and saved!
3) Added option "No vehicle damage" when starting a custom game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/af5fa7151babf752f9df560fde0b10f2ccf746c4.png

Ika - Full Revamp

Your favorite furniture store just got a major glow-up! IKA’s new design is more realistic and immersive, making shopping for decor even more enjoyable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/e2f0e5fdc6e01eead0425ab314bc1a373dcfc619.png

But that’s not all—IKA now features its very own cafeteria! Who says business can’t be delicious?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/2a2f1b98466e25d40c772b6b95df5e9177b2184c.png

Quality of Life / Bugs

One of the big focuses for this update was to clean up, streamline, and optimize some code and graphics.

This should help greatly reduce or eliminate lag spikes for each new hour, new day, and at delivery times as well as make the game run more smoothly in general!

A full list will be provided for the release, but here are some of the quality of life changes you can expect.


 Improved taxi frequency, especially at night.
 Added fade-out/fade-in when entering/exiting buildings for a smoother transition
 Camera no longer rotates when exiting a vehicle!
 You now enter a drive-in store and warehouse the same way you exit - by driving through the door!
 Fixed lighting in underground parking lots
 Fixed issue causing buildings to be owned by "undefined" when the rival shut them down
 Added ability to write custom text on glass barriers

[hr][/hr]
Please notice: This version is unstable, unoptimized and might contain game-breaking bugs which may destroy your savegame. The branch will be updated frequently as we squeeze bugs. Any progress/savegame will be lost once this testing period is over. 

This is an opportunity to help us find bugs and get some early insight into the development of our next update. The experimental/preview version of the game is not simply a way to play the new update earlier. 

Please don't leave us negative reviews based on your experience with the experimental branch, thank you! ❤️


Here's how to access the branch:

Reminder: Experimental Branch saves are not compatible with the full release
You will be rolled back to your EA 0.6 savegame when EA 0.7 is fully released.


 Right-click Big Ambitions on Steam
 Select Properties
 Select Betas
 From the dropdown menu, choose "experimental - Use at own risk - Unstable!"


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/8d2d6f2175c34e000d6706740f6d07bc802305ae.gif

Good luck!

Remember to submit Bug Reports!

If you see something weird while in-game, be sure to hit F2 to submit a bug report so we can fix it! Any information on what you did before the bug occured are greatly appreciated.

If you have additional information to contribute, or need a response, the best option is to create a thread on Steam, Reddit, Big Ambitions Forums, or our Discord, then mention that thread in the Bug Report, so I know it's yours and can reply to you!

As always, huge thanks to all of you for the support you give. Every comment, bug report, feedback and words of encouragement means the world to us. You make this whole thing possible. So from the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

~ Hovgaard Games and the entire Big Ambitions team!

notes.title: EA 0.6 - Assemble The Line
notes.content:
Big Ambitions EA 0.6: Assemble the Line

[previewyoutube=JE_tPzE8kz4;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JE_tPzE8kz4[/previewyoutube]

Hi there!

The latest update for Big Ambitions is here! The team has been working tirelessly to bring you a bunch of new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. We appreciate your patience through this longer-than-normal update! Dive in and start exploring the new improvements today!

[hr][/hr]
Factories
It is time to take your business to the next level. We’ve added factories that let you produce most of the products available from the wholesale importers. From simple hotdogs to flashy jewelry to high-tech smartwatches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/241bc4edde0f156a660deab57a07840e3ffdd37b.png

New Pier Area
Your new factories need raw materials, so we added a whole new pier area! Here you can import the materials needed to get your factory production up and running.

The beautiful pier houses three new purchasing sites:

 Lunar Tide Shipments at Pier 6 for food
 Maritime Freight Line at Pier 7 for consumer goods
 Aquatic Bay Cargo at Pier 8 for drinks

Or just take a stroll around the pier and enjoy the views!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/811b1e1e951db1c5fb591d2bea2cccce43d5ce4d.jpg


Interior Design
Get ready for a complete overhaul of our Interior Designer feature! We listened to your feedback and have streamlined the design process with an intuitive "mode" switch and a handy toolbar.

Finding the right tools are now easier than ever—right at your fingertips. Dive into a smoother, more enjoyable designing experience in our latest update!

From being able to easily copy and paste designs on all your furniture, to filling in an entire wall or floor with one click by holding “shift”, the entire process is much easier now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/ece737bfecf656577ef2654397192a08d30fbf0a.png


Moving Service
Outgrown your current space? No problem! Say goodbye to manually packing and moving items with hand trucks. The moving company fully automates the process, making your transition to a larger or different building seamless and hassle-free.

What are you waiting for? Come on down to Manhattan Movers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/e9df16561e473a38a52d4eaa22752fe910659c60.png


Indoor Delivery Spots
When you enter your apartment or business, you will now see that it has undergone renovation. All rentable spaces now have a designated delivery spot for you to receive any kind of wares directly into your home or business.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/bfd2ef2e2e6a2633d0d68ea09d94d40b434a8446.png


Overlay and UI Improvements
We've streamlined our overlays and popups for a cleaner, less intrusive experience. Now, only the most essential information is displayed, including employee names right at their desks for easier management.

Plus, we've resolved the issues with popups triggered by keyboard commands or player proximity, ensuring a more cohesive and consistent UI as our game grows in complexity. Enjoy a more intuitive experience with these quality-of-life upgrades!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/dedbccbf050cc476c860873c0ad4a0f630907723.jpg


Visual Improvements
We have been working on improving the visuals and performance of the game. This has resulted in some spectacular lighting improvements. Here is a highlight of the most noticeable changes:

 Improved "time of the day" feeling with a rotating sun.
 Moonlight shadows
 Improved exterior and interior lighting
 Each district has a different atmosphere with their own effects such as fog
 Added more trash and dirt to the streets


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/c96de3c6e2a83d911629f3f5edf8d67e264e6d29.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/ac1085593f295c17dc5ba3afe099b843cf45b36e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/df358080e38dbbce3bdfc1e6144a21eb3dfd5e5f.png


Task Management Overhaul
Previously, changing an employee's status or settings could erase their associated tasks and information. Now, we've tied tasks to the HQ, not individuals. Whether an employee leaves or changes roles, no data is lost—tasks automatically reassign or stay pending. Plus, you can now easily transfer task information when relocating, ensuring seamless operations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/ac4feab2fed1f303be478b666b362aa789ad95d9.png


Help Page Updates
The F1 help menu now features a search bar and the ability to go back and forth between pages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/1d5d9f8a0183ed7a7380881fa6fa0961b88441c9.png

And More!

The subway system has been upgraded with two new subway stations - one in Hell's Kitchen and one near Ika - plus we have a fancy new destination system to make it easier to navigate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/85ac01ce4bdeff8d7d54409ded0fd6e22ef02289.png

We've added the frequently-requested ability for the player to sit on any benches or chairs! Plus, now if you have somewhere to sit in front of your TV, you'll automatically sit there when you watch TV!

We've also balanced a few businesses:

 Hairdressers were a little too powerful
 Jewelers should now sell a few more expensive jewelry
 And Nightclubs should have some more customers at a time

And players can now buy the Delivery Truck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/95b58092744c85e9bbc9bbaae9c508c513f3be78.png

Quality of life improvements & Bugs

There are so many bug fixes, improvements and balancing we have knocked out of the park for this update.


 Starting a repeating PA contract - now you can set up a contract in advance
 Removed theft from fast food, coffee and nightclubs
 Updated the wording of the Logistics Manager popup to make it more clear
