notes.title: Release of Beta 2
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Beta 2 Release
It’s time! The biggest update of Big Ambitions (so big that we had to delay its release) is here. Are you ready to see the changes? Let’s go!

New neighborhood: Midtown
The map has been expanded! A third neighborhood has joined the game: Midtown. Fancy and with unique buildings, it’s really worth it to spend a couple of evenings (in-game, of course!) walking around there. Enjoy the awesome job the art team has done!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/midtown.png
(click for high resolution)

Market demands
Although visually is almost unnoticeable, this is a big change: the way customers look for products has been completely reworked. No more expensive jewelry stores generating several millions a day, sorry! 

Products now have a demand value, which depends on the base price of the product and the amount of businesses selling it. This means that expensive stuff is harder to sell and that competition must be contemplated. We’ve also added new random events, like shortages and hypes for specific products, which can modify either the import price of the product or the demand value. Market Insider App has received an update to match the changes, don’t worry!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/marketdemands.png
(click for high resolution)

Auto parking on Luxurious Saloon
Parking can be tricky sometimes in Big Ambitions. But, for now on, if you’re rich enough to afford a Luxurious Saloon, you’ll be able to auto park it. Fast and easy!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/autoparking.png
(click for high resolution)

New retail building
If one of your dreams in Big Ambitions is creating a big supermarket, then this is your moment! M1 building has been added to the game. With a surface of 1000m2, it can have up to 75 customers per hour.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/newretailbuilding.png
(click for high resolution)

New business type: Web Development Agency
There’s one new office business type: Web Development Agency. Set up some computers, add a bunch of programmers, and… Voila!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/webdevelopmentagency.png
(click for high resolution)

New main menu
As we get closer to the launch of Big Ambitions, we have to focus on things not directly related to gameplay. One of them is the main menu: it has been completely redesigned and improved with cool features such as the News and Updates panel! Also, saves are now splitted into characters.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/newmainmenu.png
(click for high resolution)

Autosaving
Together with the rework of the main menu, we’ve enabled autosaving. It happens every in-game midnight, and will prevent the loss of progress in case of a crash or power failure. We store up to 3 recovery saves for each character, which can be loaded from the “load menu” by enabling “Show recover saves”.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/autosaving.png
(click for high resolution)

Improved item overlays
More fancy stuff! Item overlays have received a redesign. They’re now hidden by default, and appear when hovering the mouse over the item itself. If an item is missing requirements or has low/empty stocks, an icon will appear and will always be visible.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/itemoverlays.png
(click for high resolution)

Improved schedule
One of the most annoying things of setting up a large law firm was managing the employees. We’ve done some changes here and there, like removing the space between different workstations, adding the ability to move employees between workstations by dragging, adding a “Shared schedule” option and adding toggles to all days for changing the open state. The result is something more responsive and clean!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/improvedschedule.png
(click for high resolution)

Improved cleaning
This improvement has been widely asked in the community, with different approaches. We’ve come to a solution that tries to meet all players' demands: cleaning slots now depend on cleaning workstations instead of mops (yay, one new item!), customer service employees come with cleaning skills, aaand… You can freely choose when the cleaning happens throughout the day.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/improvedcleaning.png
(click for high resolution)

Improved customer capacity UI
It was a bit confusing how customer capacity was handled, so we have updated how that information is displayed.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/improvedcustomercapacity.png
(click for high resolution)

Added sell buttons to items and vehicles
You can now sell any item/vehicle with a simple click! It will refund a 50% of the initial cost, but will let you get rid of old vehicles and furniture.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/sellbutton.png
(click for high resolution)

Building preview and more information on BizMan presentation
It’s important to know what you’re buying before actually buying it, so… We’ve added a preview button that will let you see the building itself, and customer capacity and traffic index are now displayed on the rent view in BizMan.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/buildingpreview.png
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/bizmanpresentation.png
(click for high resolution)

Desktop workstations set up
Some people have tried to set up their own desktop workstations by buying chairs, computers and desks, instead of buying the all-in-one desktop workstations. The thing is… That made more sense! So, desktop workstations are no longer available in stores, and both lawyers and programmers will need a workstation with a computer, a desk and a chair.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta2/desktopsetup.png
(click for high resolution)

Other improvements
There are a lot of small quality of life improvements and additions. Some of them are:

 Added current address information on bottom right corner
 Added warehouses as possible destination for logistics managers
 Added default lights to buildings
 Added various objects to rooftops of buildings
 Added “Static Background Image” option for Phone Apps (fixes whitescreen issue on Intel GPUs)
 “Business has no employees assigned” hourly message only appears when the business is open and has no employees assigned at all
 Added more sounds! Including random sounds for NPCs
 Grouped daily money transactions
 Improved tables performance and added sorting options
 Updated tutorial
 Disabled controllers input

Beta 1 Release
It’s the end of the month, and that means that is time for an update! After almost a year of alpha releases, we’re now moving the production phase from alpha to beta, releasing the first beta version of the game. Let’s see the new features!

New car controller & traffic improvements
As promised, we’ve changed the car controller to a more responsive one. We’ve also added engine sounds for the different vehicles. And, with this upgrade, we took the opportunity to improve the traffic, removing almost all bottlenecks and making the AI drivers smoother.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/newcarcontroller.mp4[/video]

Persona App
Time to update your phone! One more app is available on Big Ambitions, this time focusing on your character. There’s a lot to add to this app, but right now it has some basic information, plus a bunch of personal goals (similar to achievements) to complete!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/personaapp.png
(click for high resolution)

Acquire competitor businesses
You can now buy competitor businesses. It’s expensive, but will let you get that perfectly located building that you wanted! When acquiring it, both the furniture and the stock from that business will remain.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/acquirecompetitorbusiness.png
(click for high resolution)

New buildings
We have two brand new buildings available in the game: a large-sized residential apartment and a small office to build cozy headquarters and law firms.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/largesizedresidentialbuilding.png
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/smallofficebuilding.png
(click for high resolution)

Interior designer improvements
The art team has been working on new walls and floors, and we’ve added the possibility to change the colors of them, expanding the interior designer UI. With those additions, there are now available up to 24 floors and 38 walls. Will that be enough?

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/interiordesigner.png
(click for high resolution)

New furniture
This version comes with a bunch of new furniture that can be bought from Ika Bohag, like trash bins and product panels, that are smaller and cheaper alternative shelves for the cheap gifts. We’ve also added the option to place furniture on the walls, adding paintings of different sizes, clocks and TVs.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/beta1/newfurniture.png

Other improvements
There are a lot of small quality of life improvements and additions. Some of them are:

 Added the ability to attach chairs to tables

 Added sorting filters to the MyEmployees App
 Added dropdowns to shelves to select the type of product to sell

notes.title: Release of Alpha 10
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Alpha 10 Release
Initially planned for February, we're slightly late with our alpha 10 release. The new features brought fundamental changes to much of the game logic, introducing countless bugs. Today, we've finally reached a level of stability good enough for shipping the version to our gold supporters.

Savegames
Savegames from alpha 9 are still supported in alpha 10, however they need to be moved manually from the alpha 9 folder to the alpha 10 folder.
Savegames are located here:
Windows: %userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Hovgaard Games\Big Ambitions
Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Hovgaard Games/Big Ambitions
 

Take a look at all those new features:

Delivery Contracts 📝
Delivery contracts were first introduced in alpha 9. However, their handling through the contacts app didn't feel very good.

After a complete rework, you can now find delivery contracts in your shop's BizMan. Changes are easy and independent of the wholesalers' business hours.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/deliverycontractsrework.png
(click for high resolution)

Headquarters 🏢
Headquarters can be set up in any office building. Once your company grows, this is the place where all your managers will work to ease your life.

For now, you can only hire logistics managers and purchasing agents (more on this below). HR managers are scheduled for the beta 1 release.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/headquarter.png
(click for high resolution)

Warehouses and Logistics Managers 📦
Warehouses are your distribution hub. Imported goods and deliveries from wholesalers will arrive here before being distributed to your shops.

You need to drive transport vehicles into the warehouses. Delivery drivers, a new employee type, can be assigned to one of the vehicles each.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/warehouse.png
(click for high resolution)

For each warehouse, you have to hire one logistics manager. They can handle delivery routes to assure none of your businesses will ever run out of goods.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/logisticsmanager.png
(click for high resolution)

Harbor Import Businesses and Purchasing Agents 🚢
Instead of buying goods from the wholesalers, you can save some money by importing them. Currently, two import businesses are set up at the harbor warehouses.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/harborimportbusiness2.png
(click for high resolution)

Just sit down at the customer service agent inside these businesses to negotiate import contracts.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/harborimportbusiness1.png
(click for high resolution)

Similarly to logistics managers, you need to staff your headquarters with one purchasing agent for each harbor import business.

Just tell the logistics manager what items you'd like to import and which warehouse should receive them. Be aware that import contracts come with a minimum order amount.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/purchasingagent.png
(click for high resolution)

Trucks and Pallets 🚚
The new logistics features require handling increased amounts of goods. Your friendly truck dealership will be happy to provide you with modern, brand-new trucks.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/truckdealership.png
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/playerdrivablesemitrucks.gif
(click for high resolution)

Pallet shelves from AJ Pederson & Son's appliance store will be perfect for your warehouses to store whole pallets instead of single boxes.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/pallets.png
(click for high resolution)

New building entrance system for vehicles 🚘
Feedback from our gold supporters showed us a problem with buildings allowing cars to drive in. This possibility wasn't obvious, causing many players to park the car and walk into the building instead.

You'll now see clearly marked green areas. A large blue button for entering the building will show once you drive into those areas. Alternatively, you can press E.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/vehiclebuildingentrance.png
(click for high resolution)

Logo Customizer 🎨
Previously scheduled for beta 1, we finished the logo customizer ahead of time and included it in alpha 10.

Choose from one of the predefined icons or upload your own (only PNG images supported), then set up your preferred colors and a nice-looking font.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/logocustomizer.gif
(click for high resolution)

Some buildings support showing the logo beside the large name signboard.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/shoplogosign.png
(click for high resolution)

Billboard Ads 📢
Alpha 9 introduced online marketing for your business at McCain's marketing agency. We recently received word that City Ads has opened their New York branch, offering billboard ads. Now you can see your own logo on those giant billboards all over the city - isn't that cool?

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/billboardads.png
(click for high resolution)

Elevators 🔝
Elevators are just behaving like regular doors, but they look fancy.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/elevator.gif
(click for high resolution)

Movable Placement Camera 🎥
We got many complaints about item placement in buildings, and we listened! Now you can move the camera for positioning.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/placementcamera.gif
(click for high resolution)

Vehicle Improvements 🚙
Vehicles now got rearview. The camera will turn around while holding C. No matter whether you're just backing out of a traffic accident or enjoy exploring the city in reverse, the camera will help with that.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/rearcamera.gif
(click for high resolution)

New in town and low on money? Sleeping in your car might save some money, although every bone will hurt the following morning.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/sleepincar.gif
(click for high resolution)

Tree Cutout Shader 🌳
When walking through a park area, a cutout shader will create a hole in the tree leaves to keep the player visible at all times.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/treecutoutshader.gif
(click for high resolution)

Help System ❔
A first version of the help system has been added. Currently only containing a few pieces of information, partly even just dummy texts. All contents will be finished before the final release in August.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha10/helpsystem.png
(click for high resolution)

notes.title: Devlog #32
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

We're back with a first insight into the development of alpha 10, which will bring lots of new features.

Before we go into details, let's take a look at the updated Steam wishlist: 32,324!

Peek through the trees 🌳
Walking through our beautiful Madison Square Park can be difficult due to trees hiding the player. 

Jonas#2 and Ilie created a nice cutout feature to remove the leaves while walking under the trees. It's limited to the park and won't be active for single trees on the streets.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/treecutoutshader.gif
(click for high resolution)

Revised Delivery Contracts 📝
Alpha 9 brought the first version of delivery contracts, which were slightly impractical. You couldn't see them in the BizMan but only through the Contacts app (and only during business hours of the wholesales store).

Thanks to Jonas#1 and David#NaN, the next big update will bring a completely revised version. Once in contact with your favorite wholesales store, you can set up the contract easily inside the BizMan app. Multiple contracts with several wholesalers will be shown here as well. That's easier than pizza delivery!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/deliverycontractsrework.png
(click for high resolution)

Big boys need big cars 🚚
A while ago, we introduced medium-sized trucks - now it’s your turn to get hold of them!

Jonas#1 just opened the doors of our truck dealership, awaiting you with shiny new vans and trucks. Don't ask me how they got those trucks into the building...

Of course, you will be able to drive the trucks yourself. We won't even ask for a driver's license. Jonas#2 made sure steering them won't be too much of a hassle, although New York's streets for sure are far from perfect for large vehicles.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/truckdealership.png
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/playerdrivablesemitrucks.gif
(click for high resolution)

Warehouses - a forklift driver's playground 📦
Your newly bought trucks are awaited by the warehouses! Created collectively by Jonas#1, Jonas#2, David#NaN, and Daniel#1 from our 3D team, they're your new logistics hub.

Deliveries will arrive at the warehouse and are subsequently distributed to all your shops by your own trucks. Jonas#2 added pallets and a pallet shelf, relieving you of handling single boxes. Each pallet can hold up to six boxes of mixed content.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/warehouse.png
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/pallets.png
(click for high resolution)

Import cheap stuff from overseas 🚢
Having contracts is nice, but aren't those wholesales stores way too expensive? If you ever bought souvenirs from a gift shop, you might have noticed that most of them are made overseas with much lower production costs.

For this purpose, Jonas#1 introduced the Harbor Import businesses. You can't buy products right away but instead only sign delivery contracts. Those contracts have to be handled by a purchasing agent (more about them in the next section) and come with a minimum weekly purchase requirement. If you order less than required, you'll still have to pay the whole amount. In return, their low prices promise huge profits.

Just head to the harbor area and check it out once alpha 10 has arrived!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/harborimportbusiness1.png
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/harborimportbusiness2.png
(click for high resolution)

So many new tasks... I need help! 🏢
With all the new features, days might become too short for taking care of your growing company. Let's set up a headquarter!

Located in any office building of your choice, the headquarter will be the center of your power. You'll be able to hire logistics managers and purchasing agents, with more to come later. Jonas#1 and David#NaN have spent much effort to add this automation.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/headquarter.png
(click for high resolution)

Logistics managers are assigned to warehouses and take care of product distribution to your businesses. No more empty shelves! For this purpose, every logistics manager will need a van or truck at hand to do the deliveries.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/logisticsmanager.png
(click for high resolution)

Purchasing agents handle the contracts with harbor import businesses to assure that products arrive at your warehouses. You can select which products to import. Additionally, they'll tell you the required weekly purchase and when the next delivery is expected to arrive.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/purchasingagents.png
(click for high resolution)

Next stop: Floor 7 1/2! 🛗
Last but not least, Jonas#1 and David#NaN added elevators. Let's move up and down - but please don't press all buttons at once!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog32/elevator.gif
(click for high resolution)

notes.title: Release of Alpha 9
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Alpha 9 release

Although a bit late, our Christmas gift from Hovgaard Games is here: a brand new Alpha filled with many great features and quality of life improvements!

I could talk about how awesome the new features are, but it’s better if you see them yourself!

Cleaners
Let’s start with the most important addition: you can now hire and assign cleaners to your businesses! Yaay! You’ll need one mop per cleaner, and they’ll clean your business between 12 AM and 4 AM. They can also be assigned to more than one business. Just make sure not to exhaust them too much!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha9/cleaners.png
(click for high resolution)

Delivery Contracts
Another heavily asked feature: no more trips to the wholesale store! Select the item to be delivered, the amount of boxes, the day, and which business you want it to be delivered to, and there you’ll have it! At 12 AM the day selected, the hard-working people from the wholesale stores will deliver the boxes and put them on your storage shelves. Make sure you don’t run out of space or they’ll charge for the trip and won’t deliver the box.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/deliverycontract.png

Sports Car
A new faster, prettier and more dangerous car! All yours (if you ever become rich enough to afford it, of course!).

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/sportscar.jpg
(click for high resolution)

New Office Business Type (Law Firm)
One of the big features of Alpha 9 is the new law firm business: buy an office, fill it with lawyers and… Start to earn tons of money!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/lawfirm.png
(click for high resolution)

Storage Shelves and Shelves Fill Amount Visualization
Shelves now show the amount of items it has. From now on, the metal storage shelves will be used for storing boxes. Cheap Gifts will require Rounded Shelves.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/storage-space.mp4[/video]

New POI System
The Points of Interest system has been reworked, making it more professional and adding small quality of life improvements. Definitely a great upgrade!

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/newpoi.mp4[/video]

World Border
The world border is now visually filled with non-interactable buildings and in-accessible streets. Also, a “fog of war” has been added to make it even cooler!

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/fog.mp4[/video]

Contacts App
Another big feature that will definitely improve your life inside the game is the contacts app. After visiting a business and talking to an employee for the first time (cashiers excluded), a new contact will be added to the app and will let you call them to do the same you could do when visiting them. It includes: recruiting new employees, creating marketing campaigns, starting new deliveries and taking loans.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/contactapp.png
(click for high resolution)

Schedule UI Rework
After gathering and analyzing players’ feedback, we’ve completely redone the way schedules work. Now, both opening times and work shifts are modified on the same window, and we’ve designed it to make it as responsive as possible. Employees can be dragged to the work stations, and their working hours can also easily be modified. One last addition is that the opening hours now support up to two different schedules per day!

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/scheduler.mp4[/video]

Screenshot Mode
Pressing F1 will hide the UI, and pressing F2 will enable the free mode camera, letting you move and rotate as you wish! The print key button will instantly add a screenshot to the Big Ambitions folder located inside of the Pictures folder.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha9/screenshotMode.png
(click for high resolution)

Traffic System Improvements
Engine sounds and honks have been added, and vehicle lights have been updated with more realistic visuals.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/lightcookies.mp4[/video]

Zoom + Inverted Camera Rotation Option
Two more requested features have been added: zoom and the option to invert the direction when rotating the camera (can be changed through the options menu inside the main menu).

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/zoominout.mp4[/video]

Pack Furniture
Furniture can now be repacked into boxes and moved to different buildings!

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/packing.mp4[/video]

notes.title: Devlog #31
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

We're back with the first devlog in 2022 and some good progress, hoping to release alpha 9 for our gold supporters next week.

Before we go into details, let's take a look at the updated Steam wishlist: 30,671!

Plan your business hours 🕗
Based on user feedback, David#NaN and Jonas#1 have spent lots of time finishing a new UI for the business schedule.

Before, it was split into two screens: One for adjusting the business hours, and another one for setting up the employee shifts. Now it's all in one screen where you can easily set the business hours, add or remove work shifts and assign employees.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/scheduler.gif
(click for high resolution)

New business type: Office 💼
Many of our gold supporters asked for office businesses - and finally, we've got there! Jonas#1 implemented the new building type for office space and everything required to use it.

Mr. Scott will be happy to provide you with everything needed to furnish your business. He opened up his office supply store next to the existing furniture store.

The first office business available to set up is a law firm, employing lawyers. We all know that making big money starts with a good lawyer suing all competitors out of business!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/office.gif
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/lawfirm.png
(click for high resolution)

Let me guide you anywhere! 📍
Jonas#2, assisted by Jonas#1, has implemented a new POI system. Finding your way should be more convenient now with those nice-looking icons. On Voogle Maps you'll additionally see a marker indicating your current position.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/newpoi.gif
(click for high resolution)

Rotate the camera as you please 🔄
One of the most frequent complaints was the camera rotation, which felt inverted to many players. Jonas#2 added a setting allowing you to choose your preferred style.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/camerarotation.gif
(click for high resolution)

TMI! 🏷️
Currently, name labels are shown for every single item. This can look pretty chaotic at times, particularly when they overlap. Most of the information won't be needed anyways - I'm sure you recognize a mop even without a label.

In alpha 9, labels will only be displayed for relevant items - those containing additional information or buttons. Just in case you need all of them, you can still activate them temporarily by pressing .

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/labels.gif
(click for high resolution)

Are we in London, or where does all this fog come from? 🌫️
We didn't like the "world border" just showing an empty area, completely ruining the immersion in the game. That's why Jonas#2, assisted by 3d artist Paul, added buildings, roads, and the famous "fog of war". The city now seems to continue, simply keeping you back by roadblocks. No big city without road construction!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/fog.gif
(click for high resolution)

All my bags are packed, I'm ready to go... 📦
Now you can pack just everything! Eager to move into a new, bigger, more luxurious apartment? Stuff your bed, fridge, and everything else into a box - and off you go!
Besides, to make life easier for newbies, boxes placed on the floor can be picked up through left-click as well. Of course, right-click still works just as well but didn't seem to be very intuitive for new players.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog31/packing.gif
(click for high resolution)

notes.title: Devlog #30
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

After a few pretty busy weeks of development, we're back with our last devlog for this year.

Before we go into details, let's take a look at the updated Steam wishlist: 28,369!

Traffic system improvements 🚦
In our last devlog, we've already introduced the new traffic system. Jonas#2 has added sounds for the cars. You can now hear engine sounds, and vehicles will honk whenever you run in front of them. Maybe it's time to start using the sidewalk and leave the streets to those having wheels.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/honk.gif
(click for high resolution)

Additionally, car lights have been replaced by light cookies. This sounds more delicious than it actually is, but you will enjoy the new appearance. The single light block in front of cars has been replaced by two separate lights, giving it a more realistic look.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/lightcookies.gif
(click for high resolution)

Cram hand trucks into cars 🚙
Sometimes it can be annoying arriving at your shiny new apartment with lots of luxury furniture but having to move every item separately. Instead, it's now possible to cram hand trucks into the car and take it out again on arrival. Just make sure you don't ruin your car's paint!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/handtruckvehicle.gif
(click for high resolution)

Sports car for the wrooooom moments 🏎️
Another new car has been added, and this time it's a special one: The Porsche 911 inspired sports car! It won't be of much use for transporting goods, but it has speeeeeeeeeeed...

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/sportscar.jpg
(click for high resolution)

Take a closer look! 🔍
Often requested, it's finally possible to zoom in and out while walking on the streets. Zoom is limited, however, because textures wouldn't look very nice anymore when zooming in too much.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/zoominout.gif
(click for high resolution)

Are we sold out again? 🤑
Recently we introduced a change to shopping baskets, showing the number of goods inside. Jonas#2 has now extended this to all kinds of shelves. You can watch them becoming empty while customers buy your fancy overpriced gifts or cheap cigars.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/shelf-getting-empty.gif
(click for high resolution)

Storage space 📦
Metal shelves are no longer used for cheap gifts but for storing boxes instead. They can hold up to 16 of them and keep your store's floor tidy. Your employees will automatically restock empty product shelves by using these boxes.

This also simplifies gift shops as all kinds of gifts now require the same rounded shelf.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog30/storage-space.gif
(click for high resolution)

Delivery contracts 🚚
Tired of driving around the city every day just to fill up all your stores' storage? This is where delivery contracts come in handy! Your favorite wholesale store will be happy regularly sending deliveries to any of your stores. A service provided by David#NaN!

notes.title: Release of Alpha 8
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

The "New York vibes" alpha!

If you ever wanted to feel what it's like to travel around New York City… This is your moment!

After almost two months of hard work, Alpha 8 comes with huge improvements and new features that will let you enjoy (and suffer) the life of a real New Yorker: from clothing to driving, from people being everywhere to awesome parks and skyscrapers…

Alright, it might not be that real (yet)… But we are getting closer to it update through update. 

Let’s see what Alpha 8 brings!

Hell's Kitchen neighbourhood
Brand new area finished, including a park and three skyscrapers. 2nd and 3rd Street have been widened, and three new streets have been unlocked: Broadway, 1st Avenue, and 2nd Avenue. Beware: emergency services are not yet implemented. So, don't get lost in the park!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog28/hellskitchen1.png
(click for high resolution)

Advertising Agency
You can now find on 17 Third Avenue an Advertising Agency that will let you order advertising packages to boost the number of customers your business receives per hour.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog28/marketing-agency.mp4[/video]

Customer Capacity and Popularity
Available on the Bizman App, customer capacity shows how many customers per hour your business can receive. It depends on the building size and the furniture placed on the building (number of cash registers, shopping baskets, and shelves).
On the other hand, popularity depends on the overall customer satisfaction, the people reached through marketing (using the new Advertising Agency), and the customer capacity.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog29/customercapacity.png
(click for high resolution)

New traffic system
We’ve switched to a new traffic system that lets us work faster and fixes several known bugs. Now drivers stuck in traffic are more clever (and annoying).

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog29/trafficsystem.jpg
(click for high resolution)

WASD controls
Together with point and click, you can now move the player using WASD. “Satisfy players” achievement unlocked.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog28/wasd.mp4[/video]

Character Customization
Choose your character’s name, gender, skin color, head type, and clothes. Available when creating a new game.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog29/character-customization.mp4[/video]

Improved vehicle controller/mechanics
In addition to fixing known issues, the new vehicle controller is smoother and more responsive.

[video]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha-8/driving-a-car.mp4[/video]

Added more sounds/ambience
Several sounds have been added to the UI and different ambience sounds have been implemented throughout the city.

Improved performance
Overall performance has been improved with optimization of various models and systems, reducing FPS drops.

Hi friends,

We're currently in the final stages for Alpha 8, hoping to release it to our gold supporters by early December.

Before we go into details, let's take a look at the updated Steam wishlist: 25,164!

New traffic system 🚦
The previous traffic system was pretty complicated to set up and also regularly caused trouble when playing. Our gold supporters can tell stories about massive traffic jams, blocked road crossings, and trucks getting stuck when turning around corners.

The new system is less complex and easy to configure. We hope that this will massively improve traffic flow and gameplay. Don't worry - we'll still try our best to assure you get some authentic New York traffic jams in the final version.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog29/trafficsystem.jpg
(click for high resolution)

Car controller 🎮
While Jonas #1 was working on the new traffic system, Jonas #2 started working on a much-needed upgrade to the car controller, meaning the mechanics you use when driving around in your own car. 

Gold supporters will instantly notice how much easier it is to control their car, especially when parking.

Direction indicators and car lights 🚘
Cars will now tell you which direction they're planning to go! Except for those few annoying idiots who always go the opposite direction or don't know how to use indicators at all. You all know what I'm talking about!

notes.title: Alpha 7 post-release update
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

More than two weeks after our release of the Big Ambitions alpha 7 version, it's now time for a first big update. We've fixed a lot of bugs in the meantime but also include some other changes.
All changes are entirely based on player feedback, hoping to enhance the first-time playing experience.

It's all about work 💼

You're now able to start working even before your shift starts. No more waiting for the clock because you're 5 minutes early!
Besides, the fast-forward toggle of earlier versions is back. Of course, you can still use the time machine to quickly move on to the end of your shift, but for those who like to see what's happening fast-forward will come in handy.
To make things even more convenient, you don't have to click on the small cash register anymore. Just clicking on the counter will open the work dialog already.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/new-work-options.gif

Bustling New York streetlife 🚕

When leaving a building, initially the roads were left empty. Vehicles and pedestrians only slowly started to spawn. Now, this is happening all the time even while you're inside a building, so the streets will always be bustling and there's no way out of traffic jams anymore.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/bustling-streets.gif

...and even one more car on the streets! 🚘

Uncle Fred just expanded his own portfolio by buying a car dealership. Good news for you: One of the old cars wasn't good enough to be sold anymore, so you'll get it for free once you get your business running. It's old, it's in bad shape - but it's free.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/uncle-freds-car.gif

Uhm... where was it once again? 🏁

We always had two types of arrows showing directions from your current position: for your objective's destination and for a self-set destination.
To navigate even easier, we've additionally introduced flags indicating the destination. Those flags show up at the buildings while walking on the street as well as in our Voogle Maps app.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/destination-flag.jpg

Entering a building has never been so easy! 🚪

Until now, the information dialog opening when moving the mouse over a building could be a bit annoying. Depending on where you clicked you either entered the building or opened other functionality.
This has been simplified: A left-click on a building will always enter it, and a right-click on a building will always bring up a dialog containing buttons for other functionality like opening the BizMan or the Shop Sign Designer.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/building-layover-popup.gif

Objectives got simplified ✔️

The tutorial had some combined objectives like "Buy a metal shelf and stock it up with cheap gifts". Those caused some confusion and have now been split up into separate objectives, making it easier to see what's done and what's still missing.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/objectives.png

Looking for a nice place for your next business? 📝

Commercial buildings will now indicate if they're available for rent. Stop asking the neighbors and just take a look at the large "for rent" sign!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/available-for-rent.jpg

Tell me my profits! 📈

Every new day you'll now see a little popup showing your daily profits and the number of businesses. In the end, that's what it is all about: Making money!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7-postrelease/daily-profits.gif

Pest control on duty 🪲

notes.title: Release of Alpha 7
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Big things are coming your way!

Finally, we've reached a (more or less) stable version of Alpha 7. It's the biggest update we've had in Big Ambitions yet with lots of new features but also fundamental changes to the game's code.

Let's take a look at what we got for this update:

Placement System

All items now take way less space when placing them in a shop or apartment. The interior will hence look more natural and you can make much better use of the available space.
In default mode, items are still snapping to the grid. You can however place them more precisely while holding the left ALT key.
Pizza oven and industrial fryer can now be placed in one line without a large gap to the wall. Just keep a little distance in between for fire safety...

Besides the updated grid placement, you can now buy an empty modular counter to place items like the hotdog grill on top. Those restaurant items don't have to be placed on the floor anymore. It was pretty disgusting to get your hotdogs from the floor, wasn't it?
The large serving desk is gone and instead replaced by a single cash register which has to be placed on top of a counter as well. This allows you to use available space much better and even fit all fast food restaurant items into a small-sized shop. Because space is money!
Both the new single counter element and the cash register are available at the Appliance Store across from El Gato (the supermarket where you take a job early in the game).

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/placementtool.gif
(click for high resolution)

Interior Designer

You now got an interior designer for your shops and apartments. Use it to change the appearance of walls and floors. They don't have any effect on actual gameplay but are just for you to give it a personal touch. Like black walls? Pretty smart idea to hide the mold inside your fast food restaurant!
The Interior Designer is available whenever you are inside one of your own buildings.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/interiordesigner.gif
(click for high resolution)

Shop Sign Designer

The Shop Sign Designer allows you to design your shop's signboard with different styles, fonts, light colors. Currently, it's just a simple mockup, so you don't get a preview when going through all the options but only see the result after saving. Of course, later it will be updated.
The Shop Sign Designer is only available while standing in front of your business.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/sign.gif
(click for high resolution)

Citymap Camera Controller

Voogle Maps got an update as well. It allows zooming in and out using the mouse wheel as well as rotating the map through either right mouse click or Q and E keys.
Often requested, you can now even open the map while being inside a building. Hooray!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/maprotation.gif
(click for high resolution)

Draggable Windows

Some players using ultrawide screens got problems with the new map filters in Alpha 6. That's why we invented the world's first-ever draggable windows! Okay, that's not true but at least we're good at copying. The first windows allowing to be dragged all across the screen are the map filters and the new shop sign designer. More to come!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/draggable.gif
(click for high resolution)

Medium-Sized Trucks

Delivery trucks are now cruising through the city to cause traffic jams and make sure roads don't feel too empty. Isn't it fun driving through a city? Luckily you still got the subway.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7/trucksonthestreets.png
(click for high resolution)

New Businesses

We know it's hard to wake up in the morning without your favorite coffee at hand. That's why you'll be able to open your own coffee shop, serving fresh hot coffee as well as crispy croissants.
While this will make getting up easier, we also take care of those looking for a comfortable way into the night. The liquor store will sell alcoholic beverages and cigars to the stressed tycoons.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/alpha7/liquorstore.png
(click for high resolution)

Business Dynamics

Our new Market Insider app will be preinstalled on your smartphone right after updating to Alpha 7. The Corporations tab shows all the big players in the game and you all the way to the bottom. Go and change this!
The News tab will be filled whenever some corporation opens or closes a business. Regularly have a look at this to find new chances for expansion!
At the start, shops are spread randomly making every game unique. You might not always get your favorite building right away but that's just one more reason to crush those annoying competitors.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/marketinsider.png
(click for high resolution)

Employee Exhaustion

Gone are the good times when you could just make your single employee work all day! Health officials have stepped in telling you that people might get exhausted when working for too long. Seems you got to give them at least some rest in between their shifts...

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/employeeexhaustion.jpg
(click for high resolution)

Scene Merging

Just a tiny change it seems but this might be the most important change of Alpha 7: We've merged indoor and outdoor scenes. No more waiting times when leaving a building, you can walk on right away! This feels soo smooth...
Initial loading time for starting a game was massively reduced as well although you might still have to wait for a short moment before being able to make your way into the big business.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/performance-boost.gif
(click for high resolution)

Mac Support

Many of you asked for Mac support - here we are! With Alpha 7 we'll ship a build for your favorite Apple device. Let your ambitions grow!

Coming soon to a Steam client near you!

Alpha 7 is available exclusively to our Gold supporters. You can order the Gold package of Big Ambitions at www.bigambitionsgame.com to get immediate access.

We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

All the best,
Jonas#1 & Daniel#2

notes.title: Devlog #27
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

We're just in the final stages of finishing Alpha 7 after massive changes have been carried out during the last two weeks. Before we get into details, let's take a look at the updated Steam wishlist: 22,710!

Performance boost 🚀
The last updates have seen many complaints about multi-second delays when entering or leaving buildings. This happened due to the next scene being loaded.

Jonas#2 has taken care of this and just finished a massive code refactoring. The benefit is enormous, minimizing the loading time for the game and leaving no noticeable delay anymore when changing between outdoor and indoor scenes.

We're now in the final stages and hopefully can release Alpha 7 early next week.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/performance-boost.gif
(click for high resolution)

Did anybody say Mac? 🖥️
Great news for some of our gold supporters using a Mac: You can finally start playing Big Ambitions without the need for Windows emulation! Alpha 7 will be shipped for Mac as well.

For now, it will be only this single build and further minor updates will be Windows-only again but Jonas#1 is already working on full Mac support throughout all future versions.

Optimize your shop fittings 📐
Item placement has been another issue we got lots of feedback about. The placement rectangles often didn't match the actual item dimensions. For example, fridges could only be placed with some gap to the walls and didn't look very nice this way.

Jonas#2 fixed this by reducing the placement rectangles to fit the dimensions of all items. Additionally, he also added the alternative option of gridless placement. Pressing left ALT allows placing items pixel-perfect wherever you like them to be.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/precise-placement.gif
(click for high resolution)

Compete with big players 📊
With Alpha 7, corporations are introduced to Big Ambitions. Every generated shop is now owned by one of the corporations. The new market insider app will show a list of all existing corporations and give you an insight into your company value compared to the other big players.

Additionally, generated businesses will regularly open or close and bring some dynamics into the game. The news section of the market insider app will inform you about updates. Don't forget to check it out from time to time and grab lucrative buildings once they become available.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/marketinsider.png
(click for high resolution)

Second appliance store for double the shopping fun 🏬
We just realized we never told you about the addition of a second appliance store with the release of Alpha 6. Sorry for that!

It was added with the need for more appliances when adding expensive gifts and the fast-food restaurant with all its modular items. Players thus need to check out both shops when equipping their business.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/appliancestore.gif
(click for high resolution)

Sky's the limit at Hell's Kitchen! 🏗️
Our 3D geniuses Daniel#1 and Paul#1 have finished more of the impressive iconic buildings compiling Hell's Kitchen, the upcoming new neighborhood. We all love them!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/hellskitchenbuildings1.jpg
(click for high resolution)
https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog27/hellskitchenbuildings2.png
(click for high resolution)

We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

That's all for today. We'll be back in 2 weeks with further updates.

All the best,
Jonas#1 & Daniel#2

notes.title: Devlog #26
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

It's been a hectic couple of weeks. We had a lot on our hands, but also made some decisions about rewriting and improving parts of the game, which ultimately pushes the release date of Alpha 7. We expect about 1 week of delay.  We'll keep you updated on Discord and the community platform. 

Also, as always, let's look at the Steam wishlist: 22,116!

Modular buildings and the Interior Designer 🖌️
Previously, the indoor buildings were one big 3D model, allowing very little customization. As we wanted to give you guys the option to paint and modify the walls and floors of your businesses and apartments, we decided to completely redo the scene, and instead create the buildings out of modular pieces. This has the advantage of walls and floors being split into smaller 1 meter wide pieces each having its own color and material.

In a team effort, Victor and Paul #1 quickly created a pack of building pieces. Afterward both of the Jonases put together a brand new UI and new game mechanics, allowing you to freely change the look of every building you rent or own.   

We still need to add a lot of materials and color options, but now we got the skeleton done. The rest is easy peasy!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/interiordesigner.gif
(click for high resolution)

A new placement tool and stackable items (!) 🎯
"The placement tool" describes the tool you use for placing furniture and items in your business or apartment. The current version was done by Jonas #1. It worked, but wasn't very flexible and also written
at a time where our demands for the tool were a lot smaller.

We wanted to give you the option to stack items. For example, put a cash register on top of a table and so on. For the last week, Jonas #2 has been super busy putting together an incredible system that gives us all the flexibility we need, both now, but also for the future.

Over are the days of having the hotdog grill directly on the floor 🥳

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/placementtool.gif
(click for high resolution)

Building Sign Customization 🚧
For a long time, all the exterior signs on your businesses were controlled entirely by randomization. This changes in alpha 7, as you'll now have access to the "Sign Appearance Settings". You can change the font, color, sign type, and lighting colors.

Your competitor businesses will also start to have different-looking signs making the city, once again, feel more alive.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/sign.gif
(click for high resolution)

Draggable Windows 🖱️
After releasing our first game "Startup Company", one of the most requested features was "Draggable Windows". Basically, players wanted to be able to move windows around freely and only see the data they needed. 

I'm happy to say that this will be added to Big Ambitions. Right now it works for the map filters and the sign appearance settings, but we plan to add support to every window in the game. 

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/draggable.gif
(click for high resolution)

The classic sports car 🏎️
While Big Ambitions is mainly about entrepreneurship, we also want to give you the option to reach for goals, achievements, and flat-out showing off.

Daniel #1 has been making a huge effort creating this Porsche 911-inspired car from the 70s. It's a rare masterpiece that comes with a very large price tag. Buying the vehicle will instantly unlock one of the many Steam achievements and your character's own personal goals (more on than in a later devlog).

The vehicle will be sold from a new exclusive car dealer in Hell's Kitchen, only welcoming customers with a certain net worth.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/sportscar.gif
(click for high resolution)
https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/sportscar.png
(click for high resolution)

New business types: Coffee Shop & Liquor Store ☕
We're continuing to add new business types to the city and for you to open. Recently Paul #1 has been adding the furniture needed to open a Coffee Shop and a Liquor Store.

In alpha 7 you'll start seeing your competitors running these businesses around the city (yes, Central Perk will be there 😂). 

With these two added, we're now moving away from the regular retail stores and into office-based businesses. More about that in a later devlog.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog26/newstores.png
(click for high resolution)

We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

That's all for today. We'll be back in 2 weeks with further updates.

All the best,
Jonas#1 & Daniel#2

notes.title: Devlog #25
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

today we'll talk about the first feedback for Alpha 6 and the already started development of Alpha 7. But at first, let's start with the Steam wishlist: 21,131!

This number just brought us to rank #493 on the Steam Wishlist charts, finally making it into the top 500! 🎉

One Jonas isn't enough for this world 👋
While Jonas went on a short vacation trip right after releasing Alpha 6 for our gold supporters, development luckily didn't come to a halt. This was due to our newest team member Jonas#2, also known as jokoho482 who's an absolute Unity expert. With his expertise, he is a great help for the development of Big Ambitions! Besides, he keeps fixing bugs faster than they get reported. Please give him a warm welcome! 🙋‍♂️

The addition to the team also means the guy formerly known as Jonas will from now on be called Jonas#1 and reduced to just another number in the system.

Alpha 6 update 📨
Alpha 6 was released last minute just before the start of Jonas#1's vacation trip, with lots of last-minute issues still being fixed.

Luckily, the version has proved to be very stable. We had quite some minor issues coming up but no game-breaking bugs. Most feedback we got about added functionality, especially questions about the new fast food restaurant items and the furniture store were pretty common.

Talking about the furniture store, the next update will bring potted plants and finally the king-sized bed will also get fixed to allow placing it in the apartment.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/pottedplantsandkingsizedbed.jpg
(click for high resolution)

You borrow it, you have to pay it back
Gone are the times of free loans: The bank got a new computer system and discovered all the money they lent you without requiring any payback. They'll now expect daily payments and even charge interest. Those greedy bankers!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/bankloanpayback.jpg
(click for high resolution)

Rotate in Voogle Maps 🗺️
Jonas#2 got his hands on Voogle Maps and added the possibility to rotate it - now you can turn the map in any direction you want while navigating your way through New York!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/maprotation.gif
(click for high resolution)

Keep your things close
A well-known issue finally gets worked on: Carrying items like boxes, paper bags or a mop didn't look very nice because the player animation was pretty limited and the items even showed a gap to the player's hands.

We're happy to see Jonas#2 taking care of this problem, already showing great results.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/playeranimation.gif
(click for high resolution)

Treat your employees well, or else... 🙋
Jonas#1 is currently busy implementing the employee satisfaction functionality planned for Alpha 7.

Instead of "Satisfaction", the employee details will show "Exhaustion". This comes with a new "Wants & Demands" section in the employee info where your [strike]cost factors[/strike] valued staff might ask for free weekends, a coffee machine at work, retirement funds and more.

All these will slow down exhaustion while working, positively affect employee skills and ultimately raise customer satisfaction.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/employeeexhaustion.jpg
(click for high resolution)

Let the fuel flow ⛽
In the future, your vehicles will consume gas and need to be refilled at a gas station. Don't let your car run out of gas or else you might have to endure the shame of being towed to the nearest gas station and even pay for it!

The first gas station will be located in the upcoming new neighborhood "Hell's Kitchen".

Take a look at the 3D model Paul#1 just finished:

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/gasstation.png?v1
(click for high resolution)

Ship it big time 🚚
The medium-sized truck will become a very important vehicle for your business logistics. Once it's finished, you will be able to buy items in bulk from wholesale stores and store them in your own warehouses for distribution. Let's thank Daniel#1 for this beautiful truck!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/mediumsizedtruck.png
(click for high resolution)

3D guys doing 3D stuff 🎨
Our 3D artists are already working on some coffee shop appliances as well as pastries - and this does not refer to their morning break. Stay tuned for more updates in the next devlog!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/coffeeshop-machine.png
(click for high resolution)
https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog25/coffeeshop-shelf.png
(click for high resolution)

Development is continuing full speed now and we'll be back in 2 weeks with further updates.

All the best,
Jonas#1 & Daniel#2

Hi friends,

two very busy weeks working on a timely release of alpha 6 are just behind us. In the meantime, we're happy to reach a new milestone on the Steam wishlist, getting above 20,000: 20,273!

Wooden benches for a good rest 🥱
Who wouldn't enjoy a little nap every now and then? Now you can!

The first benches have been placed in the city allowing you to skip the time while waiting for businesses or the school to open.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog24/sleepingbench.jpg
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog24/sleepingbench2.jpg
(click for high resolution)

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog24/benchnap.gif
(click for high resolution)

Medium-sized apartments for rent 🏠
While benches are perfect for a short rest, your nights will get even more comfortable with the medium-sized apartment. Four rooms are just right for the rising tycoon you are!

The apartments will come unfurnished, allowing you to bring in your favorite items.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog24/mediumsizedapartment.gif
(click for high resolution)

The subway goes into service 🚇
If you don't mind spending $3 on public transport, you will now be able to travel through the city much faster than ever before. Just take the subway and choose your destination!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog24/subwayride.gif
(click for high resolution)

Bling-bling! Let's sell expensive jewelry! 💎

New map filter layout 🗺️

You can now scroll through a list of all the building types - key institutions like the wholesales market, available commercial and residential buildings as well as normal businesses.

Besides, icons for your own apartments and businesses will be shown on the map as well as when walking through the city. You will never have to endure the embarrassment of missing your own apartment's entrance again!

notes.title: Looking back at 10 days of alpha 5
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

it has been an exciting week after the release of alpha 5. We would like to thank all our gold supporters for playing this early development version and providing valuable feedback!

The Numbers 💯
Let’s get to some numbers:
190 gold supporters have already been playing Big Ambitions. We could welcome 136 of them on our community platform and got in-game feedback from 98 players.

The average playing time is 4 hours and 9 minutes, quite a bit more than we expected considering the current development progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/6cb5ecc04ec80224bb49815b4d24f42bbb558918.png

Hunting bugs 🐞
Of course, all the new players lead to very busy days. Several bugs have been found already, some more serious than others, and the most important ones have already been addressed through updates. Having started with build 123 we’ve by now reached build 139.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/4172c5aaf5b5bc16b202d9a29a08849eed7634ca.png

Valuable feedback 💌
We’re now starting to address the issues you’ve reported – not just the bugs but also improvements based on your feedback. It’s important for us that new players find their way into and through the game hassle-free and are guided properly by Uncle Fred while still keeping the excitement of discovering a few things by themselves.

Community Manager 👨‍💼
Some of you might have noticed the name Gerwanese showing up on Github and Discord. His real name is Daniel and has been helping me handling testing and managing issues on GitHub.

Starting today, Daniel is now officially part of our team. He'll be handling these devlogs, testing, managing issues, helping alpha testers and much more.

Me and the rest of the team are super happy to have Daniel onboard. Some of you might have noticed we already have one Daniel, which of course will make Daniel become Daniel #2. Not to be confused with Paul #2!

We hope you'll all give Daniel a warm welcome 🙋‍♂️

Let the money flow 💰
Currently, Big Ambitions only allows you to start four types of businesses: Gift shops, supermarkets, fast food restaurants and clothing stores. For the start, this was pretty good but after a recent revenue balancing (allowing players to actually earn money from their shops) you will soon yearn for new sources of income.

The jewelry store will bring a bit of bling-bling into the streets of New York. It will be accompanied by another new business type we won’t reveal yet.

The next train is about to depart 🚇
A frequent request by our players was an easy way to get around without walking too far. What better could there be than the New York City Subway? Soon you will be able to get from A to B within no time! Please be aware however that carrying large boxes on subway trains is against the terms of transportation and will not be allowed.

Fill up those empty deserts 🏘️
The empty area around 2nd Avenue between 1st and 4th Street will be filled with placeholder buildings. The buildings won’t have any use yet but will help to set up the final numbers for all houses in these streets already, so the current house numbers will be changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40572925/427939991f8e5a4870399ef1e6a9960505553f11.jpg

Expand your business 📈
Our 3D artists were busy finishing new assets and we will soon add a pizza oven, hot dogs, burgers and french fries to your restaurants together with a modular kitchen where all of these can be prepared.

Gift shops will add expensive gifts to their product range and be allowed to place them on a decorative rounded shelf.

Your apartment on the other hand will get a proper king-sized bed for the successful young entrepreneur you are.

We hope to keep you busy with all these new options – please continue to leave feedback through the different channels and help us create the best Big Ambitions possible!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #22
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

Let's start with a status of our wishlists: 18,501!

So the last 2 weeks have been nothing else but crazy. Especially the last 7 days, I've spent close to working 14 hours per day in order to get the alpha ready in time. Good news, it's ready, at least as ready as
it could be :-)

The alpha release is today! 🎉

Today at 19:00 CEST, the 200+ gold supporters will receive an email containing their personal Steam playtest key, granting them direct access to the latest alpha build.

I and the rest of the team are super excited to see what you all think about what we've created so far. Obviously, the game is far from done, but the current version gives a clear idea of the concept and quality of the game.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog22/steam.jpg
(click for high resolution)


Time Machine ⏱️

Until now, all passive tasks like working and sleeping would make the game run fast forward by changing the game’s internal time scale.. This forced the engine to render all assets and run all animations and a very high speed, causing low FPS and generally a bad experience.

This has now been changed with the time machine. Once you enable the machine, the rendering shuts down temporarily and time is fast-forwarded. This comes with a lot of benefits. Obviously, we’ll have a higher FPS, but another benefit is the option to control how long time it takes to fast forward. This allows me to adjust the time, so it never feels annoying. Nice!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog22/timemachine.gif
(click for high resolution)

Updated drive-in store parking and textures 🚘

We have updated the drive-in store to now include a nice parking area. Please notice, you can only park legally in the designated parking spots.

The building itself has also been optimized to better fit into the harbor area. We hope you like it!

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog22/drivein.jpg
(click for high resolution)

Improved (or worse) roads 🚧

In our Steam trailer, you might have noticed that the streets and avenues have patches and cracks all over. We have now extended these details to the rest of the city. At the same time, a few additional "decals" has been
added to increase variety.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog22/roads.gif
(click for high resolution)

Night time and lights 🌃

notes.content:

Hi friends,

I hope you're having a great Friday already!

First of all, I want to start with a status of our wishlists: 16,162!

That's more than 6,000 new wishes since the Steam page was announced. I'm super happy and proud of this number. It shows that we continue the growth and are slowly getting closer to our final goal: 50,000. 
Thank you to all of you who clicked that little, but incredibly important, wishlist button ☺

Moving on. The last 2 weeks really haven't been the most exciting. We have been running on reduced team size, and personally, I've been doing 2 major rewrites in preparations for alpha 5.
 
I did consider pushing the devlog a week but decided to go with this smaller update. I hope you like it after all 😁 

NEW PARKING SYSTEM 🅿️

A major annoyance in Big Ambitions was parking. You were only allowed to exit your vehicle if it was legally parked on a designated parking spot.

This has now been introduced with the parking zone system. Whenever your vehicle is stationary the UI will show was parking zone you're in. Right now all legal zones are free, but later on, I'll introduce
paid parking.

The player can also decide to park illegally. The UI will indicate so. This comes with a risk of receiving a parking ticket ($125). You'll only receive one ticket per day.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog20/parking.gif
(click for high resolution)

ITEM BACKEND REWRITE AND SOME UI ⚙️

Big Ambitions has already been through quite a lot of pivots, as I learned which of my ideas worked and which didn’t. For every change and modification, the source code becomes worse and eventually, you just have to invest the time to rewrite it to better suit the new reality. Geeks like us like to call it technical debt.

For the last week, I’ve been doing nothing else but rewriting the system that handles stuff like furniture, products to sell, cash registers, cooking appliances, etc.

The trigger for this rewrite was the option to empty a shelf, in order to change what it contains.

This is finally possible. When emptying a shelf (or any other item containing products), you’ll now get a cardboard box containing the exact amount of products left.

While I was at it, I also slightly redesigned the overlays for products to buy, making it a bit easier to understand pricing and quantities.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog20/itemrewrite.jpg
(click for high resolution)
https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog20/itemrewrite2.jpg
(click for high resolution)

THE CUSTOMER SATISFACTION UPDATE 🥴

The backend
The business and customer satisfaction have been a bit messed up, as it was only partially implemented.

I’ve finally been able to put it all together. Two major things were missing considering business satisfaction:

 Amount of customers wasn’t affected by customer satisfaction
 Customer satisfaction wasn’t affected by employee skills

Both things have now been included, making it much more lucrative to optimize your business.

The frontend
At the same time, I found some time to add emotions to your customers. Sometimes customers will express their thoughts about your business. This is a great way to learn what to improve.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog20/emotions.gif
(click for high resolution)


PRICE INDEXES ON RESERVED BUSINESSES 🔖

The “item rewrite”, added more flexibility to the reserved businesses, meaning the places where you buy wholesale products, industrial appliances, etc.

In this update, businesses will now sell products in different quantities at different price indexes. Eventually, this will be specific to each savegame, meaning each business will sell products at different prices. Long story short: you can roam around the city and locate businesses selling the products you need at a lower price.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog20/prices.gif
(click for high resolution)

A FEW NEW BUILDINGS AND A NEW CAR 🆕

Even tho our team size has been a bit reduced these last 2 weeks, the guys still got some stuff done. A few minutes ago Paul #1 send me these renders of one of the new harbor buildings and a new car!

The vehicle is your traditional (and boring some would say) cross-over family SUV. It comes with a great price tag and even better cargo size 😎

Some of you might find the next vehicle a bit more exciting. It’s the first exclusive vehicle (Silver and Gold packages): Mercedes S-Class.

notes.title: Devlog #19
notes.content:
We use the up-vote count below to measure how many of you read these devlogs. If you enjoyed it, please let us know by hitting the like 👍 button below, thanks! ❤

Hi friends,

We had some amazing 2 weeks since the last devlog. Lots of progress! I’m starting to feel quite confident about the forthcoming alpha release.

Let’s take a closer look:

NEW BUILDING HIDER AND MOUSE-FOLLOW 🐭

My first task after the last devlog was improving camera controls for the pedestrian view. It ended up being the biggest timewaster since we started working on BA.

The issue was mainly buildings blocking the vision to the player character. You had to constantly rotate the camera in order to see the sidewalk. My initial solution was to make the camera more intelligent and making sure the camera was always just behind the player’s back. Unfortunately, this turned out incredibly complex. The number of corner cases was through the roof. Because of the floating nature of such camera, you would sometimes feel dizzy while playing. It was a nightmare!

So I did what all gamedevs do when they get stuck: They start playing games and figure out how other devs solved it.

And so I did. The solution was simple. Stick with manual rotating the camera, but completely hide blocking buildings. The solution was super close to what we had already. The biggest issue was actually getting around corners. The old version would highlight buildings, even if you just wanted to talk past them.

To overcome this, I’m now disabling all objects, once the left mouse button is held down and navigation has started.

It took me 4 full days of trial and error to get this working. It can definitely still be improved (as anything), but I’m happy with what we got now.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog19/newmousecontroller.gif
(click for high resolution)

WELCOME TO THE HARBOR 🚢

Daniel and Paul #1 are busy finishing up the new harbor area which is planned to be ready for the alpha release. The area is highly industrial, containing everything from car dealerships to the biggest wholesale stores. We’re also planning on a large furniture store, potentially in blue and yellow colors 😎

As of writing, the status is 112 open tickets and 97 closed. You can follow the progress on our Github Issues page.

I’ll like to say thank you to all of you pre-alpha testers, both on Discord and the community website, who helped playtest and find all of these bugs. I and the rest of the team really appreciate your help!

We all look forward till next month, when we can finally invite all gold supporters to join the hunt 🕷

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog19/github.jpg


ECONOVIEW: SELECTED BUSINESS 💸

Recently I’ve been more focused on making sure players feel in control and understanding all of the numbers presented. One pitfall was the EconoView app still being halfway done. This week I added “the second level”, which is what you saw when selecting a specific business.

As you might notice, the 2 last rows indicates question marks. I’m still not sure what time range is relevant. I’ll have that added once we got some more content added to the game.

https://www.bigambitionsgame.com/assets/devlog19/econoviewbusiness.gif
(click for high resolution)

NEW CLOTHING 👖

This week we got the female characters added to Unity, but not yet implemented into the game. However, Illie, our shader guru, has been putting some work into making clothing a bit more exciting, by allowing different colors and prints. Please be aware that the current T-shirt prints are work in progress 😁

At the same time, Paul #2 has been working on some new pieces: Hoodie & Cargo Pants. Below is a quick preview of how it looks. If things go well, we can show you this in-game in the next devlog too.

UPDATED DIALOG SYSTEM 💬

I’m really happy with the outcome.

EMPLOYEE TRAINING 💪

Last but not least, it’s finally possible to train employees. To train an employee, you first have to unassigned the employee from any businesses. Once training has been initiated, the employee will be unavailable the next day. Each training session increases the selected skill by 10%. The price is based on skill type and level.
